index_text.ja: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen ノイズ除去(エッジ保存) — バイラテラルでエッジを残して平滑化し、軽く鮮鋭化して輪郭をはっきりさせる エッジ保存平滑化（bilateral filter）。HALCON の ``bilateral_filter``（bilateral filtering of an image.）に相当。 Unsharp mask. ★出口で [0,1] に clip する(2026-09-02)。
index_text.en: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen Edge-preserving smoothing (bilateral filter). Equivalent to HALCON's ``bilateral_filter`` (bilateral filtering of an image.). Unsharp mask. ★It clips to [0,1] on the way out (2026-09-02).
index_text.zh: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen 保边平滑（双边滤波器）。相当于 HALCON 的 ``bilateral_filter``（bilateral filtering of an image.）。 非锐化掩蔽。★出口处 clip 到 [0,1] (2026-09-02)。
index_text.tw: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen 保邊平滑化（雙邊濾波器）。相當於 HALCON 的 ``bilateral_filter``（bilateral filtering of an image.）。 非銳化遮罩。★出口處 clip 到 [0,1] (2026-09-02)。
index_text.ko: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen 에지 보존 평활화(bilateral filter). HALCON의 ``bilateral_filter``(bilateral filtering of an image.)에 해당한다. 언샤프 마스크. ★출구에서 [0,1] 로 clip 합니다(2026-09-02).
index_text.de: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen Kantenerhaltende Glattung (Bilateralfilter). Entspricht HALCONs ``bilateral_filter`` (bilateral filtering of an image.). Unscharfmaskierung. ★Sie klippt am Ausgang auf [0,1] (2026-09-02).
index_text.hi: Denoise — bilateral + unsharp denoise edge-preserving smooth, then a light sharpen Edge को बचाते हुए smoothing (bilateral filter)। HALCON के ``bilateral_filter`` (bilateral filtering of an image.) के समकक्ष है। Unsharp mask। ★आउटपुट पर [0,1] में clip करता है (2026-09-02)।

recipes.name: Denoise — total variation
recipes.when: ROF TV denoising
recipes.when_ja: ノイズ除去(全変動 TV) — ROF 全変動最小化で平坦部のノイズを消し、段差やエッジは保つ

index_text.ja: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising ノイズ除去(全変動 TV) — ROF 全変動最小化で平坦部のノイズを消し、段差やエッジは保つ 全変動ノイズ除去(TV denoising、Chambolle 法)。エッジを保ったまま平坦部のノイズを滑らかにする —— メディアン/ガウスぼかしと違い、輪郭のシャープさを崩しにくいのが特徴。
index_text.en: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Chambolle's method). Smooths noise in flat regions while preserving edges - unlike median/Gaussian blur, it is characterized by not easily degrading the sharpness of contours.
index_text.zh: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 全变分去噪（TV denoising，Chambolle 方法）。在保留边缘的同时平滑平坦区域的噪声——与中值/高斯模糊不同，其特点是不易破坏轮廓的锐利度。
index_text.tw: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 全變分去噪（TV denoising，Chambolle 方法）。在保留邊緣的同時平滑平坦區域的雜訊——與中值/高斯模糊不同，其特點是不易破壞輪廓的銳利度。
index_text.ko: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 전변동 노이즈 제거(TV denoising, Chambolle 기법). 에지를 보존하면서 평탄한 영역의 노이즈를 매끄럽게 한다 —— 미디언/가우시안 블러와 달리 윤곽의 선명함을 잘 무너뜨리지 않는 것이 특징이다.
index_text.de: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total-Variation-Rauschunterdrückung (TV denoising, Chambolle-Verfahren). Glättet das Rauschen in flachen Bereichen bei gleichzeitiger Erhaltung der Kanten - im Unterschied zu Median-/Gauß-Weichzeichnung zeichnet es sich dadurch aus, dass die Schärfe der Konturen nur schwer beeinträchtigt wird.
index_text.hi: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Chambolle विधि)। Edges को बचाते हुए समतल हिस्सों का noise smooth करता है —— median/Gaussian blur के विपरीत, इसकी खासियत है कि contour की sharpness आसानी से नहीं बिगड़ती।

index_text.ko: Denoise — median denoise impulse-noise friendly 중앙값(median) 필터. HALCON의 ``median_image``(Compute a median filter with various masks.)에 해당한다.
index_text.de: Denoise — median denoise impulse-noise friendly Medianfilter. Entspricht HALCONs ``median_image`` (Compute a median filter with various masks.).

recipes.name: Edge — Sobel + Otsu
recipes.when: gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map
recipes.when_ja: エッジ検出(Sobel+大津) — 平滑化後の勾配強度を大津の二値化でしきい値処理し、エッジの二値画像にする

index_text.ja: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map エッジ検出(Sobel+大津) — 平滑化後の勾配強度を大津の二値化でしきい値処理し、エッジの二値画像にする 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 Sobel 勾配の振幅(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` を正規化)。縦横それぞれの 1 次微分カーネルから勾配ベクトルの大きさを求める最も基本的なエッジ検出。 HALCON の ``sobel_amp``（Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。
index_text.en: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). The magnitude of the Sobel gradient (normalized ``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``). The most basic edge detection method, computing the magnitude of the gradient vector from the vertical and horizontal first-derivative kernels. Equivalent to HALCON's ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.).
index_text.zh: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 Sobel 梯度的振幅(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` 归一化)。由纵、横两个一阶微分核求出梯度向量大小,是最基本的边缘检测方法。相当于 HALCON 的 ``sobel_amp``(Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.)。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。
index_text.tw: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 Sobel 梯度的振幅(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` 正規化)。由縱、橫兩個一階微分核求出梯度向量大小,是最基本的邊緣偵測方法。相當於 HALCON 的 ``sobel_amp``(Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.)。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）進行的自動閾值處理。相當於 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。
index_text.ko: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. Sobel 그래디언트의 진폭(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``를 정규화). 세로·가로 각각의 1차 미분 커널로부터 그래디언트 벡터의 크기를 구하는 가장 기본적인 에지 검출. HALCON의 ``sobel_amp``(Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.)에 해당한다. 오츠 방법(Otsu's method)에 의한 자동 임계값 처리. HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다.
index_text.de: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Der Betrag des Sobel-Gradienten (normiertes ``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``). Die grundlegendste Kantenerkennung, die die Größe des Gradientenvektors aus den vertikalen und horizontalen Kernen erster Ableitung berechnet. Entspricht HALCONs ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.). Automatische Schwellenwertbildung mittels Otsu-Verfahren (Otsu's method). Entspricht HALCONs ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.).
index_text.hi: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Sobel gradient का amplitude (``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` को normalise किया गया)। खड़ी और आड़ी दिशा के क्रम 1 वाले derivative kernels से gradient vector का magnitude निकालने वाला सबसे बुनियादी edge detection। HALCON के ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.) के समकक्ष है। Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है।

recipes.name: Edge — Canny
recipes.when: smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region)
recipes.when_ja: エッジ検出(Canny) — ガウシアン平滑化してから Canny で細い輪郭線を抽出する

index_text.ja: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) エッジ検出(Canny) — ガウシアン平滑化してから Canny で細い輪郭線を抽出する 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 簡易 Canny 風エッジ検出（region を返す）。HALCON の ``edges_image``（Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.）に対応付けられているが、非極大抑制やヒステリシスしきい値処理は行わない簡略版（近似）。
index_text.en: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Simplified Canny-style edge detection (returns a region). Mapped to HALCON's ``edges_image`` (Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.), but this is a simplified version (an approximation) that does not perform non-maximum suppression or hysteresis thresholding.
index_text.zh: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 简化版 Canny 风格边缘检测（返回 region）。对应 HALCON 的 ``edges_image``（Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.），但这是一个不进行非极大值抑制和滞后阈值处理的简化版本(近似)。
index_text.tw: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 簡化版 Canny 風格邊緣偵測（回傳 region）。對應 HALCON 的 ``edges_image``（Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.），但這是不進行非極大值抑制與遲滯閾值處理的簡化版本(近似)。
index_text.ko: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 간이 Canny 스타일 에지 검출(region을 반환). HALCON의 ``edges_image``(Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.)에 대응되지만, 비최대 억제(non-maximum suppression)와 히스테리시스 임계값 처리를 수행하지 않는 간략화된 버전(근사)이다.
index_text.de: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Vereinfachte Canny-artige Kantenerkennung (gibt eine Region zurück). Ist HALCONs ``edges_image`` (Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.) zugeordnet, jedoch eine vereinfachte Version (Approximation), die weder Non-Maximum-Suppression noch Hysterese-Schwellenwertbildung durchführt.
index_text.hi: Edge — Canny edge smoothed then Canny edges (image -> region) Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। सरल Canny जैसा edge detection (region लौटाता है)। इसे HALCON के ``edges_image`` (Extract edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.) से जोड़ा गया है, लेकिन यह non-maximum suppression और hysteresis thresholding नहीं करने वाला सरल संस्करण है (सन्निकटन)।

recipes.name: Segment — blob / coin
recipes.when: smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks
recipes.when_ja: 領域分割(ブロブ・コイン) — 平滑化・二値化・穴埋め・小さなゴミ除去で、物体ごとの領域を切り出す

index_text.ja: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks 領域分割(ブロブ・コイン) — 平滑化・二値化・穴埋め・小さなゴミ除去で、物体ごとの領域を切り出す 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 小さい連結領域を面積で除去する。HALCON の ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）に相当。
index_text.en: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Removes small connected regions based on area. Equivalent to HALCON's ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.).
index_text.zh: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 填补区域内部的孔洞(完全被背景包围的区域)(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。只有未与外周相连的背景孔洞会被填补,与外周相连的凹陷不会被填补。相当于 HALCON 的 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)。 根据面积去除较小的连通区域。相当于 HALCON 的 ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）。
index_text.tw: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）進行的自動閾值處理。相當於 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 填補區域內部的孔洞(完全被背景包圍的區域)(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。只有未與外周相連的背景孔洞會被填補,與外周相連的凹陷不會被填補。相當於 HALCON 的 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)。 依面積去除較小的連通區域。相當於 HALCON 的 ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）。
index_text.ko: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 오츠 방법(Otsu's method)에 의한 자동 임계값 처리. HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다. 영역 내부의 구멍(배경으로 완전히 둘러싸인 영역)을 채운다(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``). 외곽과 연결되지 않은 배경 구멍만 채워지며, 외곽과 연결된 오목한 부분은 채워지지 않는다. HALCON의 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)에 해당. 면적을 기준으로 작은 연결 영역을 제거한다. HALCON의 ``select_shape``(Choose regions with the aid of shape features.)에 해당한다.
index_text.de: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatische Schwellenwertbildung mittels Otsu-Verfahren (Otsu's method). Entspricht HALCONs ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Füllt Löcher im Inneren einer Region (Bereiche, die vollständig vom Hintergrund umschlossen sind) mit ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Nur Hintergrundlöcher, die nicht mit dem äußeren Rand verbunden sind, werden gefüllt; Einbuchtungen, die mit dem äußeren Rand verbunden sind, bleiben ungefüllt. Entspricht HALCONs ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Entfernt kleine zusammenhängende Regionen anhand der Fläche. Entspricht HALCONs ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.).
index_text.hi: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है। Region के अंदर के छेद (background से पूरी तरह घिरे हिस्से) भरता है (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)। केवल बाहरी सीमा से न जुड़े background के छेद भरते हैं, बाहरी सीमा से जुड़े गड्ढे नहीं भरते। HALCON के ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.) के समकक्ष है। छोटे connected regions को क्षेत्रफल के आधार पर हटाता है। HALCON के ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.) के समकक्ष है।

recipes.name: Count — blobs
recipes.when: ends in a feature — the object count
recipes.when_ja: 個数カウント(ブロブ) — 二値化して穴を埋め、連結成分の数=物体の個数を数える

index_text.ja: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count 個数カウント(ブロブ) — 二値化して穴を埋め、連結成分の数=物体の個数を数える 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 連結成分の個数を数える(``ndimage.label``、既定 8 連結)。HALCON の ``count_obj``/``connection`` の既定と同じ 8 連結を採用しており、斜めに 接する 2 つの塊は 1 個として数える(4 連結にすると過剰カウントになる例 =セルカウントで実測 342 個 vs 327 個、コード内コメント参照)。HALCON の ``count_obj``（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。
index_text.en: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Counts the number of connected components (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity). Uses 8-connectivity, the same default as HALCON's ``count_obj``/``connection``, so two blobs touching diagonally are counted as one (an example where switching to 4-connectivity causes over-counting -- measured cell counts of 342 vs. 327; see the in-code comment). Equivalent to HALCON's ``count_obj`` (Number of objects in a tuple.).
index_text.zh: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 填补区域内部的孔洞(完全被背景包围的区域)(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。只有未与外周相连的背景孔洞会被填补,与外周相连的凹陷不会被填补。相当于 HALCON 的 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)。 统计连通成分的个数(``ndimage.label``,默认 8 连通)。采用与 HALCON 的 ``count_obj``/``connection`` 默认相同的 8 连通,因此对角相接的两个团块会被计为 1 个(若改为 4 连通会导致计数过多的例子——细胞计数实测为 342 个 vs 327 个,参见代码内注释)。相当于 HALCON 的 ``count_obj``(Number of objects in a tuple.)。
index_text.tw: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）進行的自動閾值處理。相當於 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 填補區域內部的孔洞(完全被背景包圍的區域)(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。只有未與外周相連的背景孔洞會被填補,與外周相連的凹陷不會被填補。相當於 HALCON 的 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)。 統計連通成分的個數(``ndimage.label``,預設 8 連通)。採用與 HALCON 的 ``count_obj``/``connection`` 預設相同的 8 連通,因此對角相接的兩個團塊會被算成 1 個(若改為 4 連通會導致計數過多的例子——細胞計數實測為 342 個 vs 327 個,參見程式碼內註解)。相當於 HALCON 的 ``count_obj``(Number of objects in a tuple.)。
index_text.ko: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 오츠 방법(Otsu's method)에 의한 자동 임계값 처리. HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다. 영역 내부의 구멍(배경으로 완전히 둘러싸인 영역)을 채운다(``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``). 외곽과 연결되지 않은 배경 구멍만 채워지며, 외곽과 연결된 오목한 부분은 채워지지 않는다. HALCON의 ``fill_up``(Fill up holes in regions.)에 해당. 연결 성분의 개수를 센다(``ndimage.label``, 기본 8-연결). HALCON의 ``count_obj``/``connection``의 기본값과 같은 8-연결을 채택하고 있어, 대각선으로 맞닿은 두 덩어리를 1개로 센다(4-연결로 하면 과다 계수되는 예 = 세포 계수 실측 342개 vs 327개, 코드 내 주석 참조). HALCON의 ``count_obj``(Number of objects in a tuple.)에 해당.
index_text.de: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatische Schwellenwertbildung mittels Otsu-Verfahren (Otsu's method). Entspricht HALCONs ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Füllt Löcher im Inneren einer Region (Bereiche, die vollständig vom Hintergrund umschlossen sind) mit ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Nur Hintergrundlöcher, die nicht mit dem äußeren Rand verbunden sind, werden gefüllt; Einbuchtungen, die mit dem äußeren Rand verbunden sind, bleiben ungefüllt. Entspricht HALCONs ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Zählt die Anzahl zusammenhängender Komponenten (``ndimage.label``, standardmäßig 8-Konnektivität). Verwendet dieselbe 8-Konnektivität wie der Standard von HALCONs ``count_obj``/``connection``, sodass zwei diagonal berührende Klumpen als einer gezählt werden (ein Beispiel, bei dem 4-Konnektivität zu Überzählung führt -- gemessene Zellzahlen von 342 gegenüber 327, siehe Kommentar im Code). Entspricht HALCONs ``count_obj`` (Number of objects in a tuple.).
index_text.hi: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है। Region के अंदर के छेद (background से पूरी तरह घिरे हिस्से) भरता है (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)। केवल बाहरी सीमा से न जुड़े background के छेद भरते हैं, बाहरी सीमा से जुड़े गड्ढे नहीं भरते। HALCON के ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.) के समकक्ष है। Connected components की संख्या गिनता है (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity)। HALCON के ``count_obj``/``connection`` के default जैसी ही 8-connectivity अपनाई गई है, इसलिए तिरछे छूने वाले 2 टुकड़ों को 1 गिना जाता है (4-connectivity से ज़्यादा गिनती हो जाती है, उदाहरण = cell count में मापा गया 342 बनाम 327, code के अंदर का comment देखें)। HALCON के ``count_obj`` (Number of objects in a tuple.) के समकक्ष है।

recipes.name: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians
recipes.when: DoG blob response
recipes.when_ja: ブロブ検出(DoG) — ガウシアン差分で、斑点・粒状の明るい点を強調する

index_text.ja: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response ブロブ検出(DoG) — ガウシアン差分で、斑点・粒状の明るい点を強調する DoG(Difference of Gaussians、ガウス差分)フィルタ。2 つの異なる σ でぼかした画像の差分を取り、LoG(Laplacian of Gaussian)に近いバンドパス応答(特定の空間周波数帯だけを強調するエッジ/ブロブ検出)を安く得る。
index_text.en: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG (Difference of Gaussians) filter. Takes the difference between images blurred with two different sigma values, cheaply obtaining a bandpass response close to LoG (Laplacian of Gaussian) - edge/blob detection that emphasizes only a specific spatial-frequency band.
index_text.zh: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG（Difference of Gaussians，高斯差分）滤波器。取用两个不同 σ 模糊后的图像之差，以低成本获得接近 LoG（Laplacian of Gaussian）的带通响应（只强调特定空间频率带的边缘/斑点检测）。
index_text.tw: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG（Difference of Gaussians，高斯差分）濾波器。取兩個不同 σ 模糊後影像的差值，以低成本取得接近 LoG（Laplacian of Gaussian）的帶通響應（僅強調特定空間頻率帶的邊緣/斑點偵測）。
index_text.ko: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG(Difference of Gaussians, 가우시안 차분) 필터. 서로 다른 두 σ로 블러 처리한 이미지의 차분을 취해, LoG(Laplacian of Gaussian)에 가까운 대역통과 응답(특정 공간 주파수 대역만 강조하는 에지/블롭 검출)을 저렴하게 얻는다.
index_text.de: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG-Filter (Difference of Gaussians, Gauß-Differenz). Bildet die Differenz zweier mit unterschiedlichem σ geglätteter Bilder und erhält dadurch kostengünstig eine Bandpassantwort, die dem LoG (Laplacian of Gaussian) nahekommt (Kanten-/Blob-Erkennung, die nur ein bestimmtes Ortsfrequenzband hervorhebt).
index_text.hi: Blobs — Difference of Gaussians features DoG blob response DoG (Difference of Gaussians) filter। 2 अलग σ से blur की गई images का अंतर लेकर, LoG (Laplacian of Gaussian) के करीब band-pass response (केवल एक खास spatial frequency band को उभारने वाला edge/blob detection) सस्ते में पाता है।

recipes.name: Shape — distance transform
recipes.when: distance to background inside each region
recipes.when_ja: 距離変換 — 二値化した各領域の内部で背景までの距離を求め、太さや中心を調べる

index_text.ja: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region 距離変換 — 二値化した各領域の内部で背景までの距離を求め、太さや中心を調べる 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 ユークリッド距離変換(``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``)を最大値で 正規化した画像。各前景画素について最も近い背景画素までの距離を表す ―― 値が大きいほど領域の「奥」にある画素。出力は ``region`` ではなく ``image`` 型になる点に注意。HALCON の ``distance_transform``（Compute the distance transformation of a region.）に相当。
index_text.en: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). An image obtained by normalizing the Euclidean distance transform (``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) by its maximum value. It represents, for each foreground pixel, the distance to the nearest background pixel -- the larger the value, the "deeper" the pixel is inside the region. Note that the output type is ``image``, not ``region``. Equivalent to HALCON's ``distance_transform`` (Compute the distance transformation of a region.).
index_text.zh: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 以最大值归一化后的欧几里得距离变换(``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``)图像。表示每个前景像素到最近背景像素的距离——数值越大,说明该像素越处于区域的"深处"。请注意输出类型是 ``image`` 而不是 ``region``。相当于 HALCON 的 ``distance_transform``(Compute the distance transformation of a region.)。
index_text.tw: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 使用大津法（Otsu's method）進行的自動閾值處理。相當於 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 以最大值正規化後的歐幾里得距離變換(``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``)影像。表示每個前景像素到最近背景像素的距離——數值越大,代表該像素越處於區域的「深處」。請注意輸出型別是 ``image`` 而非 ``region``。相當於 HALCON 的 ``distance_transform``(Compute the distance transformation of a region.)。
index_text.ko: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 오츠 방법(Otsu's method)에 의한 자동 임계값 처리. HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다. 최댓값으로 정규화한 유클리드 거리 변환(``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) 이미지. 각 전경 픽셀에 대해 가장 가까운 배경 픽셀까지의 거리를 나타낸다 -- 값이 클수록 영역의 '안쪽 깊이'에 있는 픽셀이다. 출력이 ``region``이 아니라 ``image`` 타입이 되는 점에 주의. HALCON의 ``distance_transform``(Compute the distance transformation of a region.)에 해당.
index_text.de: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatische Schwellenwertbildung mittels Otsu-Verfahren (Otsu's method). Entspricht HALCONs ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Ein Bild, das durch Normierung der euklidischen Distanztransformation (``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) auf ihren Maximalwert entsteht. Es gibt für jedes Vordergrundpixel den Abstand zum nächstgelegenen Hintergrundpixel an -- je größer der Wert, desto 'tiefer' liegt das Pixel im Inneren der Region. Zu beachten: Der Ausgabetyp ist ``image``, nicht ``region``. Entspricht HALCONs ``distance_transform`` (Compute the distance transformation of a region.).
index_text.hi: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है। Euclidean distance transform (``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) को अधिकतम मान से normalise की गई image। हर foreground pixel के लिए सबसे नज़दीकी background pixel तक की दूरी दर्शाता है ―― मान जितना बड़ा, pixel region में उतना "गहरा"। ध्यान दें कि आउटपुट ``region`` नहीं बल्कि ``image`` type का होता है। HALCON के ``distance_transform`` (Compute the distance transformation of a region.) के समकक्ष है।

recipes.name: Spots — local maxima
recipes.when: bright-spot detection
recipes.when_ja: 輝点検出(局所最大) — 平滑化後の局所的な明るいピークを点として拾う

index_text.ja: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection 輝点検出(局所最大) — 平滑化後の局所的な明るいピークを点として拾う 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 局所極大点検出。``x`` が窓内の最大値(``_k(a)``)に一致し、かつ ``x > 0.3+0.4*b`` を満たす画素だけを前景とする ―― 平坦な高原状の領域では 複数の隣接画素が同時に「極大」として残る点に注意(真の孤立点ピークだけを 残す保証はない)。HALCON の ``local_max``（Detect all local maxima in an image.）に相当。
index_text.en: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Local maxima detection. Only pixels where ``x`` matches the maximum value within the window (``_k(a)``) and also satisfy ``x > 0.3+0.4*b`` are treated as foreground -- note that in flat, plateau-like regions, multiple adjacent pixels can simultaneously remain as "maxima" (there is no guarantee that only true isolated peak points remain). Corresponds to HALCON's ``local_max`` (Detect all local maxima in an image).
index_text.zh: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 局部极大点检测。仅将``x``与窗口内最大值(``_k(a)``)一致、且满足``x > 0.3+0.4*b``的像素视为前景——需注意在平坦的高原状区域中,可能有多个相邻像素同时被保留为“极大值”(无法保证只留下真正的孤立峰值点)。相当于HALCON的``local_max``(Detect all local maxima in an image.)。
index_text.tw: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 局部極大點偵測。僅將``x``與視窗內最大值(``_k(a)``)一致、且滿足``x > 0.3+0.4*b``的像素視為前景——需注意在平坦的高原狀區域中,可能有多個相鄰像素同時被保留為「極大值」(無法保證只留下真正的孤立峰值點)。相當於HALCON的``local_max``(Detect all local maxima in an image.)。
index_text.ko: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 국소 극대점 검출. ``x``가 창 내 최댓값(``_k(a)``)과 일치하고, 또한 ``x > 0.3+0.4*b``를 만족하는 화소만을 전경으로 한다 —— 평탄한 고원 형태의 영역에서는 여러 인접 화소가 동시에 "극대"로 남을 수 있다는 점에 주의한다(진정한 고립점 피크만 남는다는 보장은 없다). HALCON의 ``local_max``(Detect all local maxima in an image.)에 해당한다.
index_text.de: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Erkennung lokaler Maxima. Nur Pixel, bei denen ``x`` dem Maximalwert innerhalb des Fensters (``_k(a)``) entspricht und zusätzlich ``x > 0.3+0.4*b`` erfüllen, gelten als Vordergrund -- zu beachten ist, dass in flachen, plateauartigen Bereichen mehrere benachbarte Pixel gleichzeitig als „Maximum" bestehen bleiben können (es gibt keine Garantie, dass nur echte isolierte Spitzenpunkte übrig bleiben). Entspricht HALCONs ``local_max`` (Detect all local maxima in an image.).
index_text.hi: Spots — local maxima features bright-spot detection Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Local maxima detection। केवल उन pixels को foreground मानता है जहाँ ``x`` window (``_k(a)``) के अधिकतम मान के बराबर है और ``x > 0.3+0.4*b`` भी पूरा होता है ―― ध्यान दें कि समतल पठार जैसे regions में कई पड़ोसी pixels एक साथ "maximum" के रूप में बचे रहते हैं (केवल असली अकेले peak points बचने की गारंटी नहीं है)। HALCON के ``local_max`` (Detect all local maxima in an image.) के समकक्ष है।

recipes.name: FA — scratch on hairline metal
recipes.when: dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped
recipes.when_ja: 外観検査 — ヘアライン金属の傷を暗視野リング照明で光らせ、背景を除いて傷の領域を検出

index_text.ja: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped 外観検査 — ヘアライン金属の傷を暗視野リング照明で光らせ、背景を除いて傷の領域を検出 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 ローリングボール法による背景差し引き。画像の輝度を地形と見立て、指定半径の球をその下から転がして得られる包絡面を背景と推定し、元画像から引き算する—— 照明ムラ(緩やかな輝度勾配)の除去に使う。 大域しきい値処理（グローバルスレッショルド）。HALCON の ``threshold``（Segment an image using global threshold.）に相当。 面積が閾値(``16+a*200`` 画素)未満の連結成分を除去する(小さなノイズ状 領域の除去)。HALCON の ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）は面積・円形度・凸性など任意の形状特徴で選別できる 汎用演算子だが、ここでは面積による足切り 1 種類に固定している(近似)。
index_text.en: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Background subtraction by the rolling-ball method. Treats image brightness as terrain, rolls a ball of a given radius underneath it, estimates the resulting envelope surface as the background, and subtracts it from the original image -- used to remove uneven illumination (gradual brightness gradients). Global thresholding. Equivalent to HALCON's ``threshold`` (Segment an image using global threshold.). Removes connected components whose area is below a threshold (``16+a*200`` pixels) -- i.e., removes small noise-like regions. HALCON's ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.) is a general-purpose operator that can filter by any shape feature such as area, circularity, or convexity, but here it is fixed to a single area-based cutoff (an approximation).
index_text.zh: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 基于滚球法(rolling ball)的背景扣除。将图像亮度视为地形,在其下方滚动指定半径的球体,以所得的包络面作为背景估计,并从原图像中减去 —— 用于去除照明不均(缓慢的亮度梯度)。 全局阈值处理（global threshold）。相当于 HALCON 的 ``threshold``（Segment an image using global threshold.）。 去除面积低于阈值(``16+a*200`` 像素)的连通成分(去除类似噪声的小区域)。HALCON 的 ``select_shape``(Choose regions with the aid of shape features.)是可以用面积、圆形度、凸性等任意形状特征进行筛选的通用算子,但这里固定为按面积截断这一种(近似)。
index_text.tw: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 基於滾球法(rolling ball)的背景扣除。將影像亮度視為地形,在其下方滾動指定半徑的球體,以所得的包絡面作為背景估計值,並從原始影像中減去 —— 用於去除照明不均(緩慢的亮度梯度)。 全域閾值處理（global threshold）。相當於 HALCON 的 ``threshold``（Segment an image using global threshold.）。 去除面積低於閾值(``16+a*200`` 像素)的連通成分(去除類似雜訊的小區域)。HALCON 的 ``select_shape``(Choose regions with the aid of shape features.)是可用面積、圓形度、凸性等任意形狀特徵篩選的通用運算子,但這裡固定為以面積截斷這一種(近似)。
index_text.ko: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 롤링볼(rolling ball)법에 의한 배경 차감. 이미지의 밝기를 지형으로 간주하여, 지정한 반지름의 공을 그 아래에서 굴려 얻어지는 포락면을 배경으로 추정하고 원본 이미지에서 빼는 방식이다 —— 조명 불균일(완만한 밝기 구배)의 제거에 사용한다. 전역 임계값 처리(global threshold). HALCON의 ``threshold``(Segment an image using global threshold.)에 해당한다. 면적이 임계값(``16+a*200`` 픽셀) 미만인 연결 성분을 제거한다(작은 노이즈성 영역 제거). HALCON의 ``select_shape``(Choose regions with the aid of shape features.)는 면적, 원형도, 볼록성 등 임의의 형상 특징으로 선별할 수 있는 범용 연산자지만, 여기서는 면적 기준의 컷오프 한 종류로 고정되어 있다(근사).
index_text.de: FA — scratch on hairline metal inspect dark-field ring light makes the torn scratch floor bright; a rolling ball (radius 9) removes the hairline glints' slow background, a fixed threshold keeps what is 0.12 above it, specks under 16 px are dropped Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Hintergrundsubtraktion nach der Rolling-Ball-Methode. Betrachtet die Bildhelligkeit als Relief, rollt eine Kugel mit angegebenem Radius darunter hindurch, schätzt die resultierende Hüllfläche als Hintergrund und subtrahiert sie vom Originalbild -- dient zur Beseitigung ungleichmäßiger Beleuchtung (allmähliche Helligkeitsgradienten). index_text.ja: FA — count holes in a back-lit plate measure back light: light passes through the holes and around the part; Otsu keeps the light, clearing what touches the border leaves only the through-holes, then count 穴の個数検査 — 透過(バックライト)照明で板の貫通穴だけを残し、穴の数を数える 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 画像端に接する成分の除去。前景領域のうち画像の外周に触れている連結成分をすべて背景に落とす —— 視野の端で切れた(全体像が写っていない)物体を解析対象から除外する定番の前処理。 連結成分の個数を数える(``ndimage.label``、既定 8 連結)。HALCON の ``count_obj``/``connection`` の既定と同じ 8 連結を採用しており、斜めに 接する 2 つの塊は 1 個として数える(4 連結にすると過剰カウントになる例 =セルカウントで実測 342 個 vs 327 個、コード内コメント参照)。HALCON の ``count_obj``（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。

Drops all connected components of the foreground region that touch the image's outer edge back to background -- a standard preprocessing step for excluding objects cut off at the edge of the field of view (not fully captured) from analysis. Counts the number of connected components (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity). Uses 8-connectivity, the same default as HALCON's ``count_obj``/``connection``, so two blobs touching diagonally are counted as one (an example where switching to 4-connectivity causes over-counting -- measured cell counts of 342 vs. 327; see the in-code comment). Equivalent to HALCON's ``count_obj`` (Number of objects in a tuple.).

index_text.ja: FA — weld porosity (X-ray) inspect pores are thinner steel, so brighter; keep pixels 0.048 above a sigma-4 local background (follows the weld cap), drop specks under 16 px 溶接部のブローホール検査(X 線) — 局所背景より明るい気孔を抽出し、溶接欠陥として検出 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 局所ガウス平滑化+オフセットによるしきい値処理(``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` にオフセット ``(b-0.5)*0.3`` を加えたものがしきい値)。 ``dyn_threshold`` と似た発想だが、局所平均を矩形窓でなくガウシアンで 求める点が異なる。HALCON の ``local_threshold``（Segment an image using local thresholding.）に相当。 面積が閾値(``16+a*200`` 画素)未満の連結成分を除去する(小さなノイズ状 領域の除去)。HALCON の ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）は面積・円形度・凸性など任意の形状特徴で選別できる 汎用演算子だが、ここでは面積による足切り 1 種類に固定している(近似)。
index_text.en: FA — weld porosity (X-ray) inspect pores are thinner steel, so brighter; keep pixels 0.048 above a sigma-4 local background (follows the weld cap), drop specks under 16 px Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Thresholding via local Gaussian smoothing plus an offset (the threshold is ``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` plus offset ``(b-0.5)*0.3``). A similar idea to ``dyn_threshold``, but differs in that the local mean is computed with a Gaussian instead of a rectangular window. Corresponds to HALCON's ``local_threshold`` (Segment an image using local thresholding). Removes connected components whose area is below a threshold (``16+a*200`` pixels) -- i.e., removes small noise-like regions. HALCON's ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.) is a general-purpose operator that can filter by any shape feature such as area, circularity, or convexity, but here it is fixed to a single area-based cutoff (an approximation).

HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 국소 가우시안 평활화 + 오프셋에 의한 임계값 처리(임계값은 ``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)``에 오프셋 ``(b-0.5)*0.3``을 더한 것). ``dyn_threshold``와 비슷한 발상이지만, 국소 평균을 사각형 창이 아닌 가우시안으로 구한다는 점이 다르다. HALCON의 ``local_threshold``(Segment an image using local thresholding.)에 해당한다. 면적이 임계값(``16+a*200`` 픽셀) 미만인 연결 성분을 제거한다(작은 노이즈성 영역 제거). HALCON의 ``select_shape``(Choose regions with the aid of shape features.)는 면적, 원형도, 볼록성 등 임의의 형상 특징으로 선별할 수 있는 범용 연산자지만, 여기서는 면적 기준의 컷오프 한 종류로 고정되어 있다(근사).
index_text.de: FA — weld porosity (X-ray) inspect pores are thinner steel, so brighter; keep pixels 0.048 above a sigma-4 local background (follows the weld cap), drop specks under 16 px Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Schwellenwertbildung durch lokale Gaußglättung plus Offset (der Schwellenwert ist ``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` zuzüglich Offset ``(b-0.5)*0.3``). Eine ähnliche Idee wie ``dyn_threshold``, unterscheidet sich aber darin, dass der lokale Mittelwert mit einem Gauß-Kern statt einem rechteckigen Fenster berechnet wird. Entspricht HALCONs ``local_threshold`` (Segment an image using local thresholding.). Entfernt zusammenhängende Komponenten, deren Fläche unter einem Schwellenwert (``16+a*200`` Pixel) liegt (Entfernung kleiner, rauschartiger Regionen). HALCONs ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.) ist ein universeller Operator, der nach beliebigen Formmerkmalen wie Fläche, Rundheit oder Konvexität filtern kann, hier jedoch fest auf einen einzigen flächenbasierten Grenzwert festgelegt ist (eine Approximation).
index_text.hi: FA — weld porosity (X-ray) inspect pores are thinner steel, so brighter; keep pixels 0.048 above a sigma-4 local background (follows the weld cap), drop specks under 16 px Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Local Gaussian smoothing + offset से thresholding (``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` में offset ``(b-0.5)*0.3`` जोड़कर threshold बनता है)। ``dyn_threshold`` जैसा ही विचार, लेकिन local mean आयताकार window के बजाय Gaussian से निकालता है, यह अंतर है। HALCON के ``local_threshold`` (Segment an image using local thresholding.) के समकक्ष है। Threshold (``16+a*200`` pixels) से कम क्षेत्रफल वाले connected components हटाता है (छोटे noise जैसे regions हटाना)। HALCON का ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.) क्षेत्रफल, circularity, convexity जैसे किसी भी shape feature से छाँट सकने वाला सामान्य operator है, लेकिन यहाँ केवल 1 प्रकार, क्षेत्रफल से कटौती, तय है (सन्निकटन)।

recipes.when: smooth, Otsu, fill holes, then the region's maximal diameter in pixels (the disk's diameter 2r; the sample's disk has r = 18 + 6·variant)
recipes.when_ja: 寸法計測 — 明るい円形部品を二値化・穴埋めし、最大径(直径、px)を測る

index_text.ja: Measure — diameter of a bright round part measure measurement 2d Regions smooth, Otsu, fill holes, then the region's maximal diameter in pixels (the disk's diameter 2r; the sample's disk has r = 18 + 6·variant) 寸法計測 — 明るい円形部品を二値化・穴埋めし、最大径(直径、px)を測る 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 領域の直径 [px] = 境界上の 2 点間の最大距離(最大弦)。HALCON の ``diameter_region``（Maximal distance between two boundary points of a region.）と同じ量・同じ単位。
index_text.en: Measure — diameter of a bright round part measure measurement 2d Regions smooth, Otsu, fill holes, then the region's maximal diameter in pixels (the disk's diameter 2r; the sample's disk has r = 18 + 6·variant) Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). The diameter of a region in pixels = the maximum distance between two boundary points (the longest chord) — the same quantity in the same unit as HALCON's ``diameter_region`` (Maximal distance between two boundary points of a region.).

index_text.ja: Inspect — roundness of a punched disk (circularity) inspect inspection 2d Regions binarize, fill, circularity 4πA/P²-style score: near 1 for a good round part, lower when it is dented or oval 真円度検査 — 打ち抜き円板の円形度(4πA/P²)を求め、へこみ・楕円変形を判定 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 円形度 ``min(1, 面積 /(π・max²))``。``max`` は**重心から輪郭画素までの最大距離** で、円なら 1、細長い形や大きな出っ張り・穴があるほど小さい。連結成分が複数ある 場合は最大面積のものだけを評価する。HALCON の ``circularity``（Shape factor for the circularity (similarity to a circle) of a region.）**と同じ式**。
index_text.en: Inspect — roundness of a punched disk (circularity) inspect inspection 2d Regions binarize, fill, circularity 4πA/P²-style score: near 1 for a good round part, lower when it is dented or oval Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Circularity ``min(1, area / (pi * max^2))``, where ``max`` is the **largest distance from the centre of gravity to a contour pixel**. It is 1 for a circle and smaller for elongated shapes or ones with large bulges or holes. If several connected components are present, only the largest one is evaluated. **The same formula as** HALCON's ``circularity`` (Shape factor for the circularity (similarity to a circle) of a region.).

recipes.name: Preprocess — remove salt-and-pepper impulses before measuring part area
recipes.when: Impulse (salt-and-pepper) noise from a faulty sensor or dust inflates a binarized area: Otsu on the raw image counts the white impulses as part pixels (+22 % here). A 3x3 median (a=0.3 -> window 3) removes isolated impulses while keeping the edge, then Otsu + area_center give the part area in px² (truth πr², r = 16 + 6·variant) and its centroid row (px).

recipes.name: Preprocess — denoise a flat field and verify the residual noise level
recipes.when: Flat grey frame with white Gaussian sensor noise (sigma 0.02 / 0.05). A 7x7 median (a=0.6) smooths it and estimate_noise (robust Laplacian-MAD sigma, grey units 0..1) checks that the residual noise dropped below half of the input sigma — a quick denoise acceptance test.

recipes.name: Inspect — count parts under strongly uneven illumination (local threshold)
recipes.when: Small bright parts on a left-to-right illumination ramp: one global Otsu threshold cuts the ramp and returns ~20 fragments. local_threshold compares each pixel with its Gaussian local mean (a=0.5 -> sigma 2.5 px, b=0.6 -> offset +0.03), a radius-1 opening (a=0.2) removes single-pixel noise, count_obj counts 8-connected parts (truth 4 / 6).
recipes.when_ja: 個数検査 — 照明ムラが強い画像を局所しきい値で二値化し、部品の個数を数える

index_text.ja: Inspect — count parts under strongly uneven illumination (local threshold) count inspection 2d Segmentation Small bright parts on a left-to-right illumination ramp: one global Otsu threshold cuts the ramp and returns ~20 fragments. local_threshold compares each pixel with its Gaussian local mean (a=0.5 -> sigma 2.5 px, b=0.6 -> offset +0.03), a radius-1 opening (a=0.2) removes single-pixel noise, count_obj counts 8-connected parts (truth 4 / 6). 個数検査 — 照明ムラが強い画像を局所しきい値で二値化し、部品の個数を数える 局所ガウス平滑化+オフセットによるしきい値処理(``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` にオフセット ``(b-0.5)*0.3`` を加えたものがしきい値)。 ``dyn_threshold`` と似た発想だが、局所平均を矩形窓でなくガウシアンで 求める点が異なる。HALCON の ``local_threshold``（Segment an image using local thresholding.）に相当。 円盤形構造要素による二値オープニング(収縮の後に膨張)。小さな突起や 細い連結部を除去しつつ、大まかな形状は保つ。HALCON の ``opening_circle``（Open a region with a circular structuring element.） に相当。 連結成分の個数を数える(``ndimage.label``、既定 8 連結)。HALCON の ``count_obj``/``connection`` の既定と同じ 8 連結を採用しており、斜めに 接する 2 つの塊は 1 個として数える(4 連結にすると過剰カウントになる例 =セルカウントで実測 342 個 vs 327 個、コード内コメント参照)。HALCON の ``count_obj``（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。
index_text.en: Inspect — count parts under strongly uneven illumination (local threshold) count inspection 2d Segmentation Small bright parts on a left-to-right illumination ramp: one global Otsu threshold cuts the ramp and returns ~20 fragments. local_threshold compares each pixel with its Gaussian local mean (a=0.5 -> sigma 2.5 px, b=0.6 -> offset +0.03), a radius-1 opening (a=0.2) removes single-pixel noise, count_obj counts 8-connected parts (truth 4 / 6). Thresholding via local Gaussian smoothing plus an offset (the threshold is ``gaussian_filter(x, 1+3*a)`` plus offset ``(b-0.5)*0.3``). A similar idea to ``dyn_threshold``, but differs in that the local mean is computed with a Gaussian instead of a rectangular window. Corresponds to HALCON's ``local_threshold`` (Segment an image using local thresholding). Binary opening with a disk-shaped structuring element (erosion followed by dilation). Removes small protrusions and thin connections while preserving the overall shape. Corresponds to HALCON's ``opening_circle`` (Open a region with a circular structuring element). Counts the number of connected components (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity). recipes.name: Inspect — split touching round parts and count them (distance-transform peaks)
recipes.when: Pairs of overlapping pellets / cells: a plain connected-component count sees one blob per pair. The Euclidean distance transform of the mask peaks at each disk centre; h-maxima (a=0.3 -> h = 0.14 of the normalised distance) keeps one marker per disk, so count_obj returns the number of individual parts (truth 4 / 6) — the marker step of a watershed split.

recipes.name: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number)
recipes.when: A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3.
recipes.when_ja: 穴数検査 — 板の打ち抜き穴の数をオイラー数で求め、穴の欠落・余分を判定

index_text.ja: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number) count inspection 2d Regions A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3. 穴数検査 — 板の打ち抜き穴の数をオイラー数で求め、穴の欠落・余分を判定 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 オイラー数(``skimage.measure.euler_number``、連結成分数から穴の数を 引いた位相不変量)。値が小さい(負に近い)ほど穴が多いことを示す。HALCON の ``euler_number``（Calculate the Euler number.）に相当。
index_text.en: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number) count inspection 2d Regions A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3. Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Euler number (``skimage.measure.euler_number``, a topological invariant equal to the number of connected components minus the number of holes). A smaller value (closer to negative) indicates more holes. Equivalent to HALCON's ``euler_number`` (Calculate the Euler number.).
index_text.zh: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number) count inspection 2d Regions A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3. 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 欧拉数(``skimage.measure.euler_number``,是连通成分数减去孔洞数得到的拓扑不变量)。数值越小(越接近负值)表示孔洞越多。相当于 HALCON 的 ``euler_number``(Calculate the Euler number.)。
index_text.tw: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number) count inspection 2d Regions A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3. 使用大津法（Otsu's method）進行的自動閾值處理。相當於 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 歐拉數(``skimage.measure.euler_number``,是連通成分數減去孔洞數所得的拓撲不變量)。數值越小(越接近負值)代表孔洞越多。相當於 HALCON 的 ``euler_number``(Calculate the Euler number.)。
index_text.ko: Inspect — count punched holes in a plate (Euler number) count inspection 2d Regions A single plate with k round holes has Euler number 1 - k (components minus holes): a missing or extra punched hole changes it. Truth k = 2 / 3. 오츠 방법(Otsu's method)에 의한 자동 임계값 처리. HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다. 오일러 수(``skimage.measure.euler_number``, 연결 성분 수에서 구멍 수를 뺀 위상 불변량). 값이 작을수록(음수에 가까울수록) 구멍이 많음을 나타낸다. HALCON의 ``euler_number``(Calculate the Euler number.)에 해당.

recipes.name: Measure — orientation angle of an elongated part
recipes.when: Principal-axis angle of a bar (pin, screw, rod) for pick-and-place alignment. orientation_region returns the HALCON angle (counter-clockwise from the column axis, rows down) scaled by 1/180 deg: multiply by 180 for degrees. Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg.
recipes.when_ja: 姿勢計測 — ピン・ねじ・棒など細長い部品の主軸角度を求め、ピッキングの位置決めに使う

index_text.ja: Measure — orientation angle of an elongated part measure measurement 2d Regions Principal-axis angle of a bar (pin, screw, rod) for pick-and-place alignment. orientation_region returns the HALCON angle (counter-clockwise from the column axis, rows down) scaled by 1/180 deg: multiply by 180 for degrees. Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg. 姿勢計測 — ピン・ねじ・棒など細長い部品の主軸角度を求め、ピッキングの位置決めに使う 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域の主軸の向き θ / 180(θ は等価楕円の長軸の角、列軸から**画面上で反時計回り**・行は 下向き、[0, 180] 度。× 180 で度。実装は ``regionprops`` の ``orientation`` を ``(orientation + π/2) / π`` で写したもの)。HALCON の ``orientation_region``（Orientation of a region.）と同じ向きの角 —— HALCON は最遠点で 向きを決めて -π..π のラジアンで返すが、ここは 180 度で畳んで [0,1] に正規化している。 ``elliptic_axis`` の Phi(ラジアン)とは θ ≡ Phi (mod π) で一致する。
index_text.en: Measure — orientation angle of an elongated part measure measurement 2d Regions Principal-axis angle of a bar (pin, screw, rod) for pick-and-place alignment. orientation_region returns the HALCON angle (counter-clockwise from the column axis, rows down) scaled by 1/180 deg: multiply by 180 for degrees. Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg. Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Orientation of the region's principal axis as θ / 180 (θ is the angle of the equivalent ellipse's major axis, measured from the column axis **counter-clockwise on screen** with rows pointing down, in [0, 180] degrees; multiply by 180 for degrees; implemented as ``regionprops``'s ``orientation`` mapped by ``(orientation + π/2) / π``). The same sense as HALCON's ``orientation_region`` (Orientation of a region.) — HALCON decides the direction by the farthest point and returns radians in -π..π, whereas this op folds to 180 degrees and normalises to [0,1]. It agrees with ``elliptic_axis``'s Phi (radians) as θ ≡ Phi (mod π).

Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg. 使用大津法（Otsu's method）进行的自动阈值处理。相当于 HALCON 的 ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）。 区域主轴方向 θ / 180(θ 为等效椭圆长轴的角度,从列轴起**在屏幕上逆时针**测量,行向下,范围 [0, 180] 度;乘以 180 即为度;实现为将 ``regionprops`` 的 ``orientation`` 按 ``(orientation + π/2) / π`` 映射)。与 HALCON 的 ``orientation_region``(Orientation of a region.)方向相同 —— HALCON 用最远点确定朝向并以 -π..π 弧度返回,这里折叠到 180 度并归一化到 [0,1]。与 ``elliptic_axis`` 的 Phi(弧度)满足 θ ≡ Phi (mod π)。

HALCON의 ``binary_threshold``(Segment an image using binary thresholding.)에 해당한다. 영역 주축의 방향 θ / 180(θ는 등가 타원 장축의 각도로, 열 축에서 **화면상 반시계 방향**으로 잼, 행은 아래 방향, [0, 180]도; 180을 곱하면 도; ``regionprops``의 ``orientation``을 ``(orientation + π/2) / π``로 사상하여 구현). HALCON ``orientation_region``(Orientation of a region.)과 같은 방향 —— HALCON은 가장 먼 점으로 방향을 정하고 -π..π 라디안으로 반환하지만, 여기서는 180도로 접어 [0,1]로 정규화한다. ``elliptic_axis``의 Phi(라디안)와 θ ≡ Phi (mod π)로 일치한다.
index_text.de: Measure — orientation angle of an elongated part measure measurement 2d Regions Principal-axis angle of a bar (pin, screw, rod) for pick-and-place alignment. orientation_region returns the HALCON angle (counter-clockwise from the column axis, rows down) scaled by 1/180 deg: multiply by 180 for degrees. Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg. Automatische Schwellenwertbildung mittels Otsu-Verfahren (Otsu's method). Entspricht HALCONs ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Ausrichtung der Hauptachse der Region als θ / 180 (θ ist der Winkel der großen Achse der äquivalenten Ellipse, von der Spaltenachse **auf dem Bildschirm gegen den Uhrzeigersinn** gemessen, Zeilen nach unten, in [0, 180] Grad; mal 180 ergibt Grad; umgesetzt als ``orientation`` von ``regionprops``, abgebildet mit ``(orientation + π/2) / π``). Derselbe Drehsinn wie HALCONs ``orientation_region`` (Orientation of a region.) — HALCON bestimmt die Richtung über den entferntesten Punkt und liefert Radiant in -π..π, hier wird auf 180 Grad gefaltet und auf [0,1] normiert. Stimmt mit dem Phi (Radiant) von ``elliptic_axis`` als θ ≡ Phi (mod π) überein.

Truth 20 / 45 deg; tolerance ~1 deg. Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है। क्षेत्र के मुख्य अक्ष की दिशा θ / 180 (θ समतुल्य दीर्घवृत्त के दीर्घ अक्ष का कोण है, स्तंभ अक्ष से **स्क्रीन पर वामावर्त** मापा गया, पंक्तियाँ नीचे की ओर, [0, 180] डिग्री; 180 से गुणा करने पर डिग्री; ``regionprops`` के ``orientation`` को ``(orientation + π/2) / π`` से मैप करके लागू)। HALCON के ``orientation_region`` (Orientation of a region.) जैसी ही दिशा —— HALCON सबसे दूर के बिंदु से दिशा तय करके -π..π रेडियन देता है, यहाँ 180 डिग्री पर मोड़कर [0,1] में सामान्यीकृत है। ``elliptic_axis`` के Phi (रेडियन) से θ ≡ Phi (mod π) के रूप में मेल खाता है।

recipes.name: Measure — equivalent-ellipse semi-axes of an oval part
recipes.when: Equivalent ellipse (same second moments) of a binarized oval: (Ra, Rb, Phi), Ra / Rb in px. Truth Ra = 32, Rb = 12 / 18 px (the oval is axis-aligned, Phi = 0; Phi is gated on a turned bar in the next recipe).
recipes.when_ja: 形状計測 — 楕円形部品の等価楕円の長半径・短半径(px)を求める

index_text.ja: Measure — equivalent-ellipse semi-axes of an oval part measure measurement 2d Regions Equivalent ellipse (same second moments) of a binarized oval: (Ra, Rb, Phi), Ra / Rb in px. Truth Ra = 32, Rb = 12 / 18 px (the oval is axis-aligned, Phi = 0; Phi is gated on a turned bar in the next recipe). 形状計測 — 楕円形部品の等価楕円の長半径・短半径(px)を求める 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域に等価な楕円(equivalent ellipse、慣性モーメントが一致する楕円)の``(Ra, Rb, Phi)`` を ``match`` ソートの 3 成分ベクトルで返す —— ``Ra``/``Rb`` は長半径・短半径(**画素**)、``Phi`` は主軸の角(ラジアン、列軸から反時計回り)。HALCON の ``elliptic_axis`` (Calculate the parameters of the equivalent ellipse.)と同じ 3 値。
index_text.en: Measure — equivalent-ellipse semi-axes of an oval part measure measurement 2d Regions Equivalent ellipse (same second moments) of a binarized oval: (Ra, Rb, Phi), Ra / Rb in px. Truth Ra = 32, Rb = 12 / 18 px (the oval is axis-aligned, Phi = 0; Phi is gated on a turned bar in the next recipe). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Returns ``(Ra, Rb, Phi)`` of the equivalent ellipse of the region (the ellipse with the same moments of inertia) as a 3-component vector of ``match`` sort — ``Ra``/``Rb`` are the major and minor semi-axes in **pixels**, ``Phi`` is the angle of the major axis (radians, counter-clockwise from the column axis). The same three values as HALCON's ``elliptic_axis`` (Calculate the parameters of the equivalent ellipse.).

recipes.when: Star bracket / connector with m arms: binarize, a radius-1 opening (a=0.1) removes edge pixel noise that would grow skeleton spurs, skeletonize, keep the skeleton end points and count them (= number of arms, 3 / 4). A broken-off arm lowers the count.

A broken-off arm lowers the count. 形状検査 — 星形ブラケット・コネクタの腕の本数を細線化の端点数で数える 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 円盤形構造要素による二値オープニング(収縮の後に膨張)。小さな突起や 細い連結部を除去しつつ、大まかな形状は保つ。HALCON の ``opening_circle``（Open a region with a circular structuring element.） に相当。 位相を保ったまま領域を 1 画素幅の骨格線に細める (``skimage.morphology.skeletonize``)。分岐や端点の位置は保存されるため、 枝分かれした形状の解析(指の本数を数える等)によく使われる。HALCON の ``skeleton``（Compute the skeleton of a region.）に相当。 骨格の端点(8 近傍にちょうど 1 個の骨格画素を持つ点)を抽出する。 連結成分の個数を数える(``ndimage.label``、既定 8 連結)。HALCON の ``count_obj``/``connection`` の既定と同じ 8 連結を採用しており、斜めに 接する 2 つの塊は 1 個として数える(4 連結にすると過剰カウントになる例 =セルカウントで実測 342 個 vs 327 個、コード内コメント参照)。HALCON の ``count_obj``（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。
index_text.en: Inspect — count the arms of a branched part (skeleton end points) count inspection 2d Regions Star bracket / connector with m arms: binarize, a radius-1 opening (a=0.1) removes edge pixel noise that would grow skeleton spurs, skeletonize, keep the skeleton end points and count them (= number of arms, 3 / 4). A broken-off arm lowers the count. Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Binary opening with a disk-shaped structuring element (erosion followed by dilation). Removes small protrusions and thin connections while preserving the overall shape. Corresponds to HALCON's ``opening_circle`` (Open a region with a circular structuring element). Thins a region to a 1-pixel-wide skeleton while preserving topology (``skimage.morphology.skeletonize``). Branch points and endpoints are preserved in position, so it is often used to analyze branching shapes (such as counting the number of fingers). Equivalent to HALCON's ``skeleton`` (Compute the skeleton of a region.). Extract the end points of a skeleton (the points with exactly one skeleton pixel in their 8-neighbourhood). Counts the number of connected components (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity). Uses 8-connectivity, the same default as HALCON's ``count_obj``/``connection``, so two blobs touching diagonally are counted as one (an example where switching to 4-connectivity causes over-counting -- measured cell counts of 342 vs. 327; see the in-code comment). Equivalent to HALCON's ``count_obj`` (Number of objects in a tuple.).

Truth 23.5 / 31.5. エッジ位置計測 — 勾配の列方向投影プロファイルの最大から縦エッジの位置(px)を求める 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 Sobel 勾配の振幅(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` を正規化)。縦横それぞれの 1 次微分カーネルから勾配ベクトルの大きさを求める最も基本的なエッジ検出。 HALCON の ``sobel_amp``（Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.）に相当。 画像を 1 方向へ潰した**射影プロファイル**を 1-D の signal にする ―― 版面解析の基本量。
index_text.en: Measure — edge column from the gradient projection profile measure measurement 2d Filters Smooth (sigma 1.1 px), Sobel gradient magnitude, then average the columns into a 1-D profile (b<0.5 -> length W); the profile's maximum is the column of a vertical edge (px). Truth 23.5 / 31.5. Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). The magnitude of the Sobel gradient (normalized ``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``). The most basic edge detection method, computing the magnitude of the gradient vector from the vertical and horizontal first-derivative kernels. Equivalent to HALCON's ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.). Turns the **projection profile**, obtained by collapsing the image along 1 direction, into a 1-D signal — a basic quantity of page-layout analysis.

recipes.name: Measure — sub-pixel edge position along a caliper line
recipes.when: measure_pos: a horizontal caliper through the image centre (a=0 -> theta 0), edges where the smoothed profile derivative peaks above 30 % of the strongest (b=0.3), refined to sub-pixel by a 3-point parabola. Output contour points (row, col) in px; the step sits at col 23.5 / 31.5.

Gibt die Positionen, an denen ein festgelegtes Grauwertniveau (``0,2+0,5*a``) durchquert wird, als Kontur mit Subpixel-Genauigkeit zurück. Entspricht HALCONs ``threshold_sub_pix`` (Extract level crossings from an image with subpixel accuracy.). Passt an die Kontur mit den meisten Punkten eine Ellipse an (``cv2.fitEllipse``) und liefert ``(Ra, Rb, Phi)`` als 3-komponentigen Vektor der Sorte ``match`` — ``Ra``/``Rb`` sind große und kleine Halbachse [px], ``Phi`` der Hauptachsenwinkel (Radiant, von der Spaltenachse **auf dem Bildschirm gegen den Uhrzeigersinn**, Zeilen nach unten, größer als -π/2 und höchstens π/2). Dieselben drei Werte wie HALCONs ``elliptic_axis_xld`` (Parameters of the equivalent ellipse of contours or polygons.).
index_text.hi: Measure — radius of a round part by an ellipse fit to its sub-pixel edge measure measurement 2d XLD Least-squares ellipse fit (cv2.fitEllipse) to the iso-contour; for a round part both semi-axes are the radius in px (18 / 24), their difference is an ovality measure. There is no circle-fit op that returns the radius (see MISSING_OPS). Marching squares विधि (``skimage.measure.find_contours``) से level crossing (contour line) extraction। दिए गए tone level (``0.2+0.5*a``) को पार करने वाली positions को sub-pixel सटीकता वाले contours के रूप में लौटाता है। HALCON के ``threshold_sub_pix`` (Extract level crossings from an image with subpixel accuracy.) के समकक्ष है। सबसे अधिक बिंदुओं वाले कंटूर पर दीर्घवृत्त फ़िट करता है (``cv2.fitEllipse``) और ``(Ra, Rb, Phi)`` को ``match`` सॉर्ट के 3-घटक सदिश के रूप में लौटाता है —— ``Ra``/``Rb`` अर्ध-दीर्घ और अर्ध-लघु अक्ष [px], ``Phi`` मुख्य अक्ष कोण (रेडियन, स्तंभ अक्ष से **स्क्रीन पर वामावर्त**, पंक्तियाँ नीचे की ओर, -π/2 से बड़ा और अधिकतम π/2)। HALCON के ``elliptic_axis_xld`` (Parameters of the equivalent ellipse of contours or polygons.) जैसे ही 3 मान।

recipes.name: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit
recipes.when: Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg.
recipes.when_ja: 角度計測 — サブピクセルのエッジ点に直線を当てはめ、直線エッジの傾き角度を求める

index_text.ja: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit measure measurement 2d XLD Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg. 角度計測 — サブピクセルのエッジ点に直線を当てはめ、直線エッジの傾き角度を求める 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 サブピクセル精度のエッジ輪郭抽出。勾配とその法線方向(``gradient_ normals``)を求め、非極大抑制(Canny と同じ、法線方向の両隣より強い画素だけ)で 1 画素幅に細らせ、しきい値(``0.15+0.5*a``、最大勾配で正規化した強度)を超える画素を **曲線に沿って並べた輪郭**に繋ぎ(分岐点で別の輪郭に分ける。閉じたエッジは始点で閉じる)、 放物線当てはめで各点を法線方向にサブピクセル位置へ精密化する(``subpixel_ refine_edges``、``ops`` 側の同名 op と共有する実装 ―― 2026-09-02 修正で 真の意味でサブピクセルになった。旧実装は整数画素座標をそのまま返して いた)。HALCON の ``edges_sub_pix``（Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.）に相当。 各 XLD 輪郭を 1 本の直線で近似する。HALCON の ``fit_line_contour_xld``（Approximate XLD contours by line segments.）に相当。 Principal-axis orientation in degrees, folded to [0,180) and /180 scaled.
index_text.en: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit measure measurement 2d XLD Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg. Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Sub-pixel-accurate edge contour extraction. Computes the gradient and its normal direction (``gradient_normals``), thins it to one pixel by non-maximum suppression (as in Canny: only pixels stronger than both neighbours along the normal), links the pixels above the threshold (``0.15+0.5*a``, strength normalised by the maximum gradient) into **contours ordered along the curve** (split into separate contours at branch points; a closed edge is closed at its start point), and refines each point along the normal to sub-pixel position by parabola fitting (``subpixel_refine_edges``, an implementation shared with the same-named op on the ``ops`` side -- a 2026-09-02 fix made it genuinely sub-pixel; the old implementation returned integer pixel coordinates). Equivalent to HALCON's ``edges_sub_pix`` (Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.). Approximates each XLD contour with a single straight line. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fit_line_contour_xld`` (Approximate XLD contours by line segments.). Principal-axis orientation in degrees, folded to [0,180) and /180 scaled.
index_text.zh: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit measure measurement 2d XLD Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg. 各向同性高斯平滑。相当于 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 亚像素精度的边缘轮廓提取。求出梯度及其法线方向(``gradient_normals``),用非极大值抑制(与 Canny 相同,仅保留沿法线方向强于两侧的像素)细化为单像素宽,把超过阈值(``0.15+0.5*a``,按最大梯度归一化的强度)的像素连接成**沿曲线排序的轮廓**(在分支点处拆分为不同轮廓,闭合边缘在起点闭合),再用抛物线拟合沿法线把各点精细化到亚像素位置(``subpixel_refine_edges``,与 ``ops`` 侧同名 op 共享的实现 —— 经 2026-09-02 的修复才成为真正的亚像素;旧实现直接返回整数像素坐标)。相当于 HALCON 的 ``edges_sub_pix``(Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.)。 用一条直线近似每条 XLD 轮廓。相当于 HALCON 的 ``fit_line_contour_xld``（Approximate XLD contours by line segments.）。 主轴方向 [度],折叠到 [0,180) 并除以 180。

Truth 15 / 35 deg. 等向性高斯平滑化。相當於 HALCON 的 ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）。 次像素精度的邊緣輪廓擷取。求出梯度及其法線方向(``gradient_normals``),以非極大值抑制(與 Canny 相同,只保留沿法線方向強於兩側的像素)細化為單像素寬,把超過閾值(``0.15+0.5*a``,以最大梯度正規化的強度)的像素連接成**沿曲線排序的輪廓**(在分支點拆成不同輪廓,封閉邊緣在起點封閉),再以拋物線擬合沿法線把各點精細化到次像素位置(``subpixel_refine_edges``,與 ``ops`` 側同名 op 共用的實作 —— 經 2026-09-02 的修正才成為真正的次像素;舊實作直接回傳整數像素座標)。相當於 HALCON 的 ``edges_sub_pix``(Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.)。 以一條直線近似每條 XLD 輪廓。相當於 HALCON 的 ``fit_line_contour_xld``（Approximate XLD contours by line segments.）。 主軸方向 [度],摺疊到 [0,180) 並除以 180。

Truth 15 / 35 deg. 등방성 가우시안 평활화. HALCON의 ``gauss_filter``(Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.)에 해당한다. 서브픽셀 정밀도의 에지 윤곽 추출. 그래디언트와 그 법선 방향(``gradient_normals``)을 구하고, 비최대 억제(Canny와 같이 법선 방향 양옆보다 강한 화소만)로 1화소 폭으로 가늘게 한 뒤, 임계값(``0.15+0.5*a``, 최대 그래디언트로 정규화한 강도)을 넘는 화소를 **곡선을 따라 정렬한 윤곽**으로 잇고(분기점에서 다른 윤곽으로 나누며, 닫힌 에지는 시작점에서 닫음), 포물선 피팅으로 각 점을 법선 방향으로 서브픽셀 위치까지 정밀화한다(``subpixel_refine_edges``, ``ops`` 쪽 동명 op와 공유하는 구현 —— 2026-09-02 수정으로 진정한 서브픽셀이 됨. 이전 구현은 정수 화소 좌표를 그대로 반환). HALCON의 ``edges_sub_pix``(Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.)에 해당. 각 XLD 윤곽을 하나의 직선으로 근사한다. HALCON의 ``fit_line_contour_xld``(Approximate XLD contours by line segments.)에 해당한다. 주축 방향 [도]. [0,180) 로 접고 /180 로 정규화.
index_text.de: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit measure measurement 2d XLD Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg. Isotrope Gauß-Glättung. Entspricht HALCONs ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Subpixelgenaue Extraktion von Kantenkonturen. Berechnet den Gradienten und seine Normalenrichtung (``gradient_normals``), dünnt per Non-Maximum-Suppression (wie bei Canny: nur Pixel, die stärker als beide Nachbarn entlang der Normalen sind) auf ein Pixel aus, verbindet die Pixel über der Schwelle (``0.15+0.5*a``, auf den maximalen Gradienten normierte Stärke) zu **entlang der Kurve geordneten Konturen** (an Verzweigungen in getrennte Konturen geteilt, eine geschlossene Kante wird an ihrem Startpunkt geschlossen) und verfeinert jeden Punkt entlang der Normalen per Parabelanpassung auf Subpixelposition (``subpixel_refine_edges``, eine mit dem gleichnamigen Op auf der ``ops``-Seite geteilte Implementierung -- erst ein Fix vom 2026-09-02 machte sie wirklich subpixelgenau; die alte Implementierung gab ganzzahlige Pixelkoordinaten zurück). Entspricht HALCONs ``edges_sub_pix`` (Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.). Approximiert jede XLD-Kontur durch eine einzelne Gerade. Entspricht HALCONs ``fit_line_contour_xld`` (Approximate XLD contours by line segments.). Hauptachsenorientierung in Grad, auf [0,180) gefaltet und durch 180 skaliert.
index_text.hi: Measure — angle of a straight edge by a sub-pixel line fit measure measurement 2d XLD Sub-pixel edge points (gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30), total-least-squares line fit, then the line's orientation scaled to [0,1) (x 180 = degrees, measured in (row, col) coordinates, i.e. (180 - theta) for an edge turned theta counter-clockwise on screen). Truth 15 / 35 deg. Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। सब-पिक्सेल सटीकता से किनारे के कंटूर निकालना। ग्रेडिएंट और उसकी लंब दिशा (``gradient_normals``) निकालता है, नॉन-मैक्सिमम सप्रेशन (Canny जैसा: लंब दिशा में दोनों पड़ोसियों से मज़बूत पिक्सेल ही) से एक पिक्सेल चौड़ा करता है, सीमा (``0.15+0.5*a``, अधिकतम ग्रेडिएंट से सामान्यीकृत ताक़त) से ऊपर के पिक्सेलों को **वक्र के साथ क्रमबद्ध कंटूर** में जोड़ता है (शाखा बिंदुओं पर अलग कंटूर, बंद किनारा अपने आरंभ बिंदु पर बंद), और परवलय फ़िटिंग से हर बिंदु को लंब दिशा में सब-पिक्सेल स्थिति तक परिष्कृत करता है (``subpixel_refine_edges``, ``ops`` पक्ष के समान नाम वाले op के साथ साझा कार्यान्वयन —— 2026-09-02 के सुधार से सचमुच सब-पिक्सेल बना; पुराना कार्यान्वयन पूर्णांक पिक्सेल निर्देशांक लौटाता था)। HALCON के ``edges_sub_pix`` (Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.) के समतुल्य। हर XLD contour को 1 सीधी रेखा से approximate करता है। HALCON के ``fit_line_contour_xld`` (Approximate XLD contours by line segments.) के समकक्ष है। Principal axis की दिशा degrees में, [0,180) में मोड़ी गई और /180 से scale की गई।

recipes.name: Measure — perimeter of a round part from sub-pixel edges
recipes.when: Smooth, sub-pixel edges (non-maximum suppressed to one pixel, gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30, linked along the curve and refined along the normal), then the contour length in px: 2·pi·r = 113.1 / 150.8 for r 18 / 24 (measured 113.5 / 151.7). Before 2026-11-03 the edge band's pixels came in raster order and the length was 2508 px.
recipes.when_ja: 周長計測 — 平滑化してサブピクセルエッジ(1 画素幅・曲線に沿って並ぶ)を取り、輪郭長 = 2πr を測る

index_text.ja: Measure — perimeter of a round part from sub-pixel edges measure measurement 2d XLD Smooth, sub-pixel edges (non-maximum suppressed to one pixel, gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30, linked along the curve and refined along the normal), then the contour length in px: 2·pi·r = 113.1 / 150.8 for r 18 / 24 (measured 113.5 / 151.7). Before 2026-11-03 the edge band's pixels came in raster order and the length was 2508 px. 周長計測 — 平滑化してサブピクセルエッジ(1 画素幅・曲線に沿って並ぶ)を取り、輪郭長 = 2πr を測る 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 サブピクセル精度のエッジ輪郭抽出。勾配とその法線方向(``gradient_ normals``)を求め、非極大抑制(Canny と同じ、法線方向の両隣より強い画素だけ)で 1 画素幅に細らせ、しきい値(``0.15+0.5*a``、最大勾配で正規化した強度)を超える画素を **曲線に沿って並べた輪郭**に繋ぎ(分岐点で別の輪郭に分ける。閉じたエッジは始点で閉じる)、 放物線当てはめで各点を法線方向にサブピクセル位置へ精密化する(``subpixel_ refine_edges``、``ops`` 側の同名 op と共有する実装 ―― 2026-09-02 修正で 真の意味でサブピクセルになった。旧実装は整数画素座標をそのまま返して いた)。HALCON の ``edges_sub_pix``（Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.）に相当。 すべての輪郭の線分長(隣接点間のユークリッド距離)を合計した総延長。 複数の輪郭がある場合はまとめて加算する。HALCON の ``length_xld``（Length of contours or polygons.）に相当。
index_text.en: Measure — perimeter of a round part from sub-pixel edges measure measurement 2d XLD Smooth, sub-pixel edges (non-maximum suppressed to one pixel, gradient threshold 0.3 -> 0.30, linked along the curve and refined along the normal), then the contour length in px: 2·pi·r = 113.1 / 150.8 for r 18 / 24 (measured 113.5 / 151.7). Before 2026-11-03 the edge band's pixels came in raster order and the length was 2508 px. Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Sub-pixel-accurate edge contour extraction. Computes the gradient and its normal direction (``gradient_normals``), thins it to one pixel by non-maximum suppression (as in Canny: only pixels stronger than both neighbours along the normal), links the pixels above the threshold (``0.15+0.5*a``, strength normalised by the maximum gradient) into **contours ordered along the curve** (split into separate contours at branch points; a closed edge is closed at its start point), and refines each point along the normal to sub-pixel position by parabola fitting (``subpixel_refine_edges``, an implementation shared with the same-named op on the ``ops`` side -- a 2026-09-02 fix made it genuinely sub-pixel; the old implementation returned integer pixel coordinates). Equivalent to HALCON's ``edges_sub_pix`` (Extract sub-pixel precise edges using Deriche, Lanser, Shen, or Canny filters.). The total length obtained by summing the segment lengths (Euclidean distance between adjacent points) of all contours. When there are multiple contours, they are all added together. recipes.name: Inspect — segment a coloured part by saturation (HSV)
recipes.when: RGB -> HSV (a=0), take the saturation channel (a=0.4 -> channel 1) and threshold it at 0.3: the blue part is kept, the grey tray and a grey decoy of the same luminance are rejected (on the luminance image a grey threshold cannot separate them). Area px² and centroid row.

recipes.when: zoom_image_factor scales rows by 0.7 + 0.6·a and columns by 0.7 + 0.6·b about the centre (a = b = 0.75 -> 1.15 x); the part area must grow by 1.15² (canvas unchanged).

A non-isotropic zoom with independent scale factors for the height and width directions (``0.7+0.6*a``, ``0.7+0.6*b``). Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Returns the area and centroid of a region as the 3-component vector ``(area [pixel count], centroid row [px], centroid column [px])`` — the same three values in the same units as HALCON's ``area_center`` (Area and center of regions.).
