recipes.name: Preprocess — mirror an image upside down (row flip)
recipes.when: mirror_image with a=0.1 flips the rows (row -> H-1-row; a=0.9 transposes instead, measured), the column stays. For camera mounted upside down / mirror optics.
recipes.when_ja: 画像反転 — 上下反転(鏡像)で逆さ取付けのカメラやミラー光学系の画像を直す

index_text.ja: Preprocess — mirror an image upside down (row flip) transform preprocess 2d Transformations mirror_image with a=0.1 flips the rows (row -> H-1-row; a=0.9 transposes instead, measured), the column stays. For camera mounted upside down / mirror optics. 画像反転 — 上下反転(鏡像)で逆さ取付けのカメラやミラー光学系の画像を直す ``a`` の値で 3 通りの鏡映を切り替える(``a<0.34``: 上下反転、 ``a<0.67``: 左右反転、それ以外: 転置)。連続的な鏡映変換ではなく離散的な モード選択である点に注意。HALCON の ``mirror_image``（Mirror an image.）に 相当(HALCON は上下/左右/対角を明示的なモード引数で選ぶが、ここでは ``a`` の値域で疑似的に選ぶ近似)。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域の面積と重心を ``(面積 [画素数], 重心の行 [px], 重心の列 [px])`` の 3 成分ベクトルで返す。HALCON の ``area_center``（Area and center of regions.）と同じ 3 値・同じ単位。
index_text.en: Preprocess — mirror an image upside down (row flip) transform preprocess 2d Transformations mirror_image with a=0.1 flips the rows (row -> H-1-row; a=0.9 transposes instead, measured), the column stays. For camera mounted upside down / mirror optics. Switches between three types of mirroring based on the value of ``a`` (``a<0.34``: vertical flip, ``a<0.67``: horizontal flip, otherwise: transpose). Note that this is a discrete mode selection rather than a continuous mirroring transformation. A Cartesian-to-polar coordinate transform (``cv2.warpPolar``). Using the image center as the pole and ``min(H,W)/2`` as the maximum radius, it converts ring-shaped content into a wide, unrolled representation. Unmapped pixels are filled with 0 (``dst`` is zero-cleared beforehand, and the return value from cv2 is read -- an implementation note detailed in the code comments explains that reading the ``dst`` buffer itself can sometimes come back empty). Corresponds to HALCON's ``polar_trans_image`` (Transform an image to polar coordinates). Turns the **projection profile**, obtained by collapsing the image along 1 direction, into a 1-D signal — a basic quantity of page-layout analysis.

recipes.name: Inspect — dark contamination spots on a woven fabric
recipes.when: Periodic weave (period 6 px) hides small spots from any global threshold. An FFT low-pass (a=0.1 -> cutoff 0.09 cycles/px) removes the weave frequency (0.17), a 9x9 black top-hat (a=0.9) isolates the dark spots, threshold and count (1 / 3).

recipes.name: Preprocess — OpenVX affine warp, then gauge where the edge moved
recipes.when: OpenVX 1.3 warp-affine on an 8-bit frame (inverse mapping: output (x,y) samples input M·(x,y,1)); a translation of +5 / +9 px moves the step edge from 23.5 to 28.5 / 32.5, read back with a caliper
recipes.when_ja: アフィン変換 — OpenVX の画像ワープで平行移動し、エッジ位置の移動量を測って確認

index_text.ja: Preprocess — OpenVX affine warp, then gauge where the edge moved measure preprocess vx Transformations OpenVX 1.3 warp-affine on an 8-bit frame (inverse mapping: output (x,y) samples input M·(x,y,1)); a translation of +5 / +9 px moves the step edge from 23.5 to 28.5 / 32.5, read back with a caliper アフィン変換 — OpenVX の画像ワープで平行移動し、エッジ位置の移動量を測って確認 アフィン変換(3.56 節)。**逆写像**: 出力の画素 (x, y) は入力の (x0, y0) から取る(REQ-0498): ``x0 = M[0,0]·x + M[0,1]·y + M[0,2]``、``y0 = M[1,0]·x + M[1,1]·y + M[1,2]``。 回転測定矩形(長軸 ``phi`` 方向に 1 px 間隔でプロファイルを取る)を定義 (gen_measure_rectangle2)。サンプル数 n = max(2, round(2*length1)+1)、始点は 中心から -(n-1)/2 px の位置。``length2`` は幅方向の平均化幅 [px]。 測定線上のエッジ位置(サブピクセル)と振幅を抽出(measure_pos)。
index_text.en: Preprocess — OpenVX affine warp, then gauge where the edge moved measure preprocess vx Transformations OpenVX 1.3 warp-affine on an 8-bit frame (inverse mapping: output (x,y) samples input M·(x,y,1)); a translation of +5 / +9 px moves the step edge from 23.5 to 28.5 / 32.5, read back with a caliper Affine transform (Section 3.56). **Inverse mapping**: output pixel (x, y) is taken from input (x0, y0) (REQ-0498): ``x0 = M[0,0]·x + M[0,1]·y + M[0,2]``, ``y0 = M[1,0]·x + M[1,1]·y + M[1,2]``. Defines a rotated measurement rectangle (the profile is sampled at 1 px spacing along the major axis in direction ``phi``) (gen_measure_rectangle2). Number of samples n = max(2, round(2*length1)+1); the start point lies -(n-1)/2 px from the center. ``length2`` is the averaging width across the profile [px]. Extracts edge positions (subpixel) and amplitudes along the measurement line (measure_pos).

index_text.en: Preprocess — OpenVX look-up table, then 16-bin histogram histogram preprocess vx Filters OpenVX table lookup (here an inverting LUT 255 - v, U8) then the integer-binned histogram (16 bins of 16 levels). Accepts U8 and S16 (REQ-0422). The output dtype is the table's dtype. index_text.ja: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) 翼の前縁半径 — 翼断面を翼弦長で正規化し、前縁の曲率半径を求める NACA 4 桁翼型を閉形式で生成する。返りは ``(N, 2)`` の一筆書き。 弦長 1・前縁が原点・弦が +x になるよう回転と並進で正規化する。 前縁半径(翼弦比)。前縁近傍の点に円を当てはめる。
index_text.en: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) Generates a NACA 4-digit airfoil in closed form. Returns an ``(N, 2)`` outline traced in a single continuous stroke. Normalises by rotation and translation so that the chord length is 1, the leading edge is at the origin and the chord points along +x. Leading-edge radius (as a fraction of the chord). Fits a circle to the points near the leading edge.
index_text.zh: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) 以闭式生成 NACA 4 位数翼型。返回 ``(N, 2)`` 的一笔画轮廓。 通过旋转和平移进行归一化，使弦长为 1、前缘位于原点、弦朝向 +x。 前缘半径(与弦长之比)。对前缘附近的点拟合圆。
index_text.tw: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) 以閉合式產生 NACA 4 位數翼型。回傳 ``(N, 2)`` 的一筆畫輪廓。 以旋轉與平移進行正規化，使弦長為 1、前緣位於原點、弦朝向 +x。 前緣半徑(與弦長之比)。對前緣附近的點擬合圓。
index_text.ko: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) NACA 4자리 익형을 닫힌 식으로 생성한다. 반환값은 ``(N, 2)``의 한붓그리기 윤곽. 시위 길이 1, 앞전이 원점, 시위가 +x 방향이 되도록 회전과 평행 이동으로 정규화한다. 앞전 반경(시위 길이 대비 비율). 앞전 근방의 점에 원을 피팅한다.
index_text.de: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) Erzeugt ein NACA-4-Ziffern-Profil in geschlossener Form. Rückgabe: ``(N, 2)``, in einem durchgehenden Zug umlaufend. Normiert durch Rotation und Translation so, dass die Sehnenlänge 1 ist, die Vorderkante im Ursprung liegt und die Sehne in +x zeigt. Vorderkantenradius (relativ zur Sehnenlänge). Passt einen Kreis an die Punkte nahe der Vorderkante an.
index_text.hi: Measure — airfoil leading-edge radius measure measurement profile 2D Metrology leading-edge radius of a blade section after normalising to unit chord; for NACA 00tt the design value is 1.1019·t² (t = 0.12 / 0.18 -> 0.0159 / 0.0357 chord) NACA 4-अंक airfoil closed form में बनाता है। ``(N, 2)`` की एक लगातार stroke वाली outline लौटाता है। rotation और translation से normalise करता है ताकि chord की लंबाई 1 हो, leading edge origin पर हो और chord +x की ओर हो। leading-edge त्रिज्या (chord के अनुपात में)। leading edge के पास के point पर वृत्त fit करता है।

recipes.name: 3D — radius of a ball from a noisy scan with stray points
recipes.when: Measure a spherical part (ball, bearing, probe tip) from a 3-D scan that also caught stray points: voxel-grid downsampling evens out the density (voxel 0.04 units), then RANSAC sphere fitting (inlier band 0.02) ignores the outliers. Output: centre and radius in the scan's units.

index_text.ja: 3D — radius of a ball from a noisy scan with stray points measure 3d 3d 3D Object Model Measure a spherical part (ball, bearing, probe tip) from a 3-D scan that also caught stray points: voxel-grid downsampling evens out the density (voxel 0.04 units), then RANSAC sphere fitting (inlier band 0.02) ignores the outliers. Fits a sphere (centre and radius) to a point cloud with outlier-robust RANSAC.

recipes.name: 3D — ball radius by least squares after statistical outlier removal
recipes.when: Clean a scan before a plain (non-robust) least-squares fit: statistical outlier removal drops points whose mean distance to their 16 neighbours is beyond mean + 2 std, then the algebraic sphere fit gives (centre, radius). Without the cleaning the 40 stray points bias the radius by ~15 %; after it the error is ~1 %.

recipes.name: 3D — pipe radius from a cylinder scan (normals + RANSAC cylinder)
recipes.when: Measure the radius and axis of a pipe, shaft or bore from its point cloud: PCA normals from 16 neighbours, then RANSAC cylinder (axis from normal cross products). Radius in scan units.
recipes.when_ja: 円筒当てはめ — 点群の法線と RANSAC で配管・軸・穴の半径と軸方向を求める

index_text.ja: 3D — pipe radius from a cylinder scan (normals + RANSAC cylinder) measure 3d 3d 3D Object Model Measure the radius and axis of a pipe, shaft or bore from its point cloud: PCA normals from 16 neighbours, then RANSAC cylinder (axis from normal cross products). Radius in scan units. 円筒当てはめ — 点群の法線と RANSAC で配管・軸・穴の半径と軸方向を求める 点群 (N,3) → 単位法線(局所 k 近傍共分散の最小固有ベクトル=PCA)。 外れ値に頑健な RANSAC 円筒適合(点法線が必要)。
index_text.en: 3D — pipe radius from a cylinder scan (normals + RANSAC cylinder) measure 3d 3d 3D Object Model Measure the radius and axis of a pipe, shaft or bore from its point cloud: PCA normals from 16 neighbours, then RANSAC cylinder (axis from normal cross products). recipes.name: 3D — how far a part sits from its nominal pose (point-to-plane ICP -> pose error)
recipes.when: Placement check of a fixtured part: register the measured scan onto the reference (point-to-plane ICP), then compare the recovered pose (R, t) with the nominal pose — rotation error in degrees (geodesic angle of R_estᵀ·R_nominal) and translation error |t_est − t_nominal| in scan units. The nominal pose is the identity, so the error is the applied motion (6 / 10 deg, ~0.06 / 0.1).

recipes.name: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM
recipes.when: Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll.
recipes.when_ja: スカイライン — 標高データから観測点で見える地平線(稜線)を求め、屋外カメラの位置合わせに使う

index_text.ja: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. スカイライン — 標高データから観測点で見える地平線(稜線)を求め、屋外カメラの位置合わせに使う DEM の 1 点から見た**全方位のスカイライン**(方位ごとの地平線仰角)→ table。 スカイライン table と姿勢から、その向きのカメラが見る**空のマスク**(H, W)を描く → image2d(0/1)。 写真から**列ごとの空と地形の境界の行**を動的計画法で 1 本抜く → signal (W,)。
index_text.en: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. **Omnidirectional skyline** seen from 1 point of the DEM (horizon elevation per azimuth) → table. From a skyline table and an orientation, draws the **sky mask** (H, W) seen by a camera pointing that way → image2d (0/1). Extracts from a photo, by dynamic programming, 1 line giving **the row of the sky–terrain boundary for each column** → signal (W,).
index_text.zh: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. 从 DEM 的 1 个点看到的**全方位天际线**(各方位的地平线仰角)→ table。 根据天际线 table 与姿态，绘制该朝向的相机所看到的**天空掩膜**(H, W)→ image2d(0/1)。 用动态规划从照片中提取 1 条**每列的天空与地形分界所在行** → signal (W,)。
index_text.tw: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. 從 DEM 的 1 個點看到的**全方位天際線**(各方位的地平線仰角)→ table。 根據天際線 table 與姿態，繪製該朝向的相機所看到的**天空遮罩**(H, W)→ image2d(0/1)。 以動態規劃從照片中擷取 1 條**每欄的天空與地形分界所在列** → signal (W,)。
index_text.ko: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. DEM의 1점에서 본 **전방위 스카이라인**(방위마다의 지평선 앙각) → table. 스카이라인 table과 자세로부터 그 방향의 카메라가 보는 **하늘 마스크**(H, W)를 그린다 → image2d(0/1). 사진에서 **열마다의 하늘과 지형 경계의 행**을 동적 계획법으로 1개 뽑는다 → signal (W,).
index_text.de: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. **Rundum-Skyline**, gesehen von 1 Punkt des DEM (Horizontelevation je Azimut) → table. Zeichnet aus einer Skyline-Tabelle und einer Orientierung die **Himmelsmaske** (H, W), die eine so ausgerichtete Kamera sieht → image2d (0/1). Extrahiert aus einem Foto per dynamischer Programmierung 1 Linie mit **der Zeile der Grenze zwischen Himmel und Gelände für jede Spalte** → signal (W,).
index_text.hi: Sense — horizon line a camera sees from a DEM simulate simulation geocam  Geo-registration of an outdoor camera: skyline (horizon elevation per azimuth, earth curvature included) from a DEM at the observer, render the sky mask a north-facing camera would see, then extract the sky/terrain boundary row per column (dynamic programming) — the signal you match against a photo to solve the camera's yaw/pitch/roll. DEM के 1 point से दिखने वाली **सभी दिशाओं की skyline** (हर azimuth पर horizon elevation) → table। skyline table और orientation से, उस दिशा में देखते camera को दिखने वाला **आकाश का mask** (H, W) बनाता है → image2d (0/1)। photo से dynamic programming द्वारा **हर column के लिए आकाश–terrain सीमा की row** वाली 1 line निकालता है → signal (W,)।

recipes.name: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot
recipes.when: Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic).
recipes.when_ja: スリットスキャン — 動画の 1 行を時間方向に並べ、移動物体の筋の傾きから速度(px/フレーム)を読む

index_text.ja: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). スリットスキャン — 動画の 1 行を時間方向に並べ、移動物体の筋の傾きから速度(px/フレーム)を読む 立方体の断面 1 枚(``image2d``)。``"xt"`` = 行 ``position`` のスリットスキャン (T, W)、``"yt"`` = 列の (T, H)、 ``"xy"`` = 時刻 ``position`` のフレーム (H, W)。``position`` は [0, 1] の割合(行・列・時刻の何割目か)。
index_text.en: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). One cross-section of the cube (``image2d``). ``"xt"`` = slit scan of row ``position`` (T, W), ``"yt"`` = (T, H) of a column, ``"xy"`` = the frame at time ``position`` (H, W). ``position`` is a fraction in [0, 1] (what fraction along the rows, columns or time).
index_text.zh: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). 立方体的一张截面(``image2d``)。``"xt"`` = 行 ``position`` 的狭缝扫描 (T, W)，``"yt"`` = 列的 (T, H)，``"xy"`` = 时刻 ``position`` 的帧 (H, W)。``position`` 是 [0, 1] 的比例(位于行、列、时刻的几成处)。
index_text.tw: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). 立方體的一張截面(``image2d``)。``"xt"`` = 列 ``position`` 的狹縫掃描 (T, W)，``"yt"`` = 行的 (T, H)，``"xy"`` = 時刻 ``position`` 的影格 (H, W)。``position`` 是 [0, 1] 的比例(位於列、行、時刻的幾成處)。
index_text.ko: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). 입방체의 단면 1장(``image2d``). ``"xt"`` = 행 ``position``의 슬릿 스캔 (T, W), ``"yt"`` = 열의 (T, H), ``"xy"`` = 시각 ``position``의 프레임 (H, W). ``position``은 [0, 1]의 비율(행·열·시각의 몇 할째인지).
index_text.de: Sense — slit-scan (x-t) image of a moving spot analyze analysis videocube  Space-time slit scan: cut the video cube along one image row over time; a moving object becomes a slanted streak whose slope is its speed in px / frame (conveyor, web inspection, traffic). recipes.name: Sense — sun elevation at a site over a day
recipes.when: Sun azimuth / elevation (deg) for a list of UTC times at a known site (NOAA solar calculator, Meeus): the day's sun track for shading / glare prediction and for orienting a fixed camera from the sun. recipes.name: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF)
recipes.when: image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling)
recipes.when_ja: 解像力評価 — F 値から回折限界のエアリー像と MTF を求め、MTF50(lp/mm)を出す

index_text.ja: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) 解像力評価 — F 値から回折限界のエアリー像と MTF を求め、MTF50(lp/mm)を出す The diffraction-limited PSF of a circular pupil (Airy pattern). Radially-averaged MTF of a measured point-spread function. SFR(pairs: 周波数, 値)が 0.5 を**最初に**切る周波数(直線補間)。0.5 を切らなければ ``ValueError`` (「測れる範囲の上まで 0.5 以上」を最大値として黙って返さない)。
index_text.en: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) The diffraction-limited PSF of a circular pupil (Airy pattern). Radially-averaged MTF of a measured point-spread function. The frequency at which the SFR (pairs: frequency, value) **first** drops below 0.5 (linear interpolation). If it never drops below 0.5, ``ValueError`` (it does not silently return "0.5 or above up to the top of the measurable range" as the maximum value).
index_text.zh: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) 圆形光瞳的衍射极限 PSF(艾里图样)。 由实测点扩散函数得到径向平均的 MTF。 SFR(pairs：频率，值)**首次**低于 0.5 时的频率(线性插值)。若从未低于 0.5，则 ``ValueError`` (不会把“直到可测范围上限都在 0.5 以上”默默当作最大值返回)。
index_text.tw: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) 圓形光瞳的繞射極限 PSF(艾里圖樣)。 由實測點擴散函數得到徑向平均的 MTF。 SFR(pairs：頻率，值)**首次**低於 0.5 時的頻率(線性內插)。若從未低於 0.5，則 ``ValueError`` (不會把「直到可量測範圍上限都在 0.5 以上」默默當作最大值回傳)。
index_text.ko: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) 원형 동공의 회절 한계 PSF(에어리 패턴). 측정한 점확산함수로부터 동경 평균한 MTF. SFR(pairs: 주파수, 값)이 0.5를 **처음으로** 밑도는 주파수(선형 보간). 0.5를 밑돌지 않으면 ``ValueError`` ("측정 가능한 범위의 위까지 0.5 이상"을 최댓값으로 조용히 반환하지 않는다).
index_text.de: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) Die beugungsbegrenzte PSF einer kreisförmigen Pupille (Airy-Muster). Radial gemittelte MTF aus einer gemessenen Punktspreizfunktion. Die Frequenz, bei der die SFR (pairs: Frequenz, Wert) **erstmals** unter 0.5 fällt (lineare Interpolation). Fällt sie nie unter 0.5, ``ValueError`` (es wird nicht stillschweigend „bis zum oberen Ende des Messbereichs 0.5 oder mehr“ als Maximalwert zurückgegeben).
index_text.hi: Optics — diffraction-limited MTF50 of an f-number (Airy PSF to MTF) measure optics optics  image quality: Airy point spread function of a perfect lens (lambda 0.55 um, f/5.6 or f/8, sampled at 0.5 um), its MTF and the spatial frequency where contrast drops to 50 % in lp/mm; matches the closed form 0.404 / (lambda N) of the incoherent diffraction MTF within 3 % (sampling) circular pupil का diffraction-limited PSF (Airy pattern)। measured point-spread function का radially-averaged MTF। वह frequency जहाँ SFR (pairs: frequency, मान) **पहली बार** 0.5 से नीचे जाता है (linear interpolation)। 0.5 से नीचे न जाए तो ``ValueError`` ("मापने योग्य range के ऊपर तक 0.5 या अधिक" को अधिकतम मान के रूप में चुपचाप नहीं लौटाता)।

recipes.name: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping
recipes.when: time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm
recipes.when_ja: ToF 距離計測 — 2 周波数の位相を組み合わせて折返しを解き、間接 ToF カメラの距離(m)を求める

index_text.ja: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm ToF 距離計測 — 2 周波数の位相を組み合わせて折返しを解き、間接 ToF カメラの距離(m)を求める 距離の図 → 間接 ToF の生信号(周波数ごとに K 段のバケット、電子数)。``table``(``dict``)を返す。 K 段の生信号 → 位相・振幅・オフセット・折り返した距離・画素ごとの距離の雑音の見積もり(``table``)。 複数の周波数の位相 → 距離(多周波アンラップ)。``table`` を返す。
index_text.en: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm Depth map → raw indirect-ToF signal (K phase-step buckets per modulation frequency, in electrons). Returns a ``table`` (``dict``). K-step raw signal → phase, amplitude, offset, wrapped depth and a per-pixel depth-noise estimate (``table``). Phases at several frequencies → depth (multi-frequency unwrapping). Returns a ``table``.
index_text.zh: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm 距离图 → 间接 ToF 的原始信号(每个调制频率 K 个相位步进的累积桶,单位为电子数)。返回 ``table``(``dict``)。 K 步原始信号 → 相位、振幅、偏移、折返距离以及逐像素的距离噪声估计(``table``)。 多个频率的相位 → 距离(多频解包裹)。返回 ``table``。
index_text.tw: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm 距離圖 → 間接 ToF 的原始訊號(每個調變頻率 K 個相位步進的累積桶,單位為電子數)。回傳 ``table``(``dict``)。 K 步原始訊號 → 相位、振幅、偏移、折返距離以及逐像素的距離雜訊估計(``table``)。 多個頻率的相位 → 距離(多頻解包裹)。回傳 ``table``。
index_text.ko: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm 거리 맵 → 간접 ToF의 원시 신호(변조 주파수마다 K단 버킷, 전자 수). ``table``(``dict``)을 반환한다. K단 원시 신호 → 위상·진폭·오프셋·접힌 거리·화소별 거리 잡음 추정(``table``). 여러 주파수의 위상 → 거리(다주파 언랩). ``table``을 반환한다.
index_text.de: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm Tiefenkarte → rohes indirektes ToF-Signal (K Phasenstufen-Buckets je Modulationsfrequenz, in Elektronen). Gibt eine ``table`` (``dict``) zurück. K-stufiges Rohsignal → Phase, Amplitude, Offset, gefaltete Tiefe und eine Schätzung des Tiefenrauschens je Pixel (``table``). Phasen bei mehreren Frequenzen → Tiefe (Mehrfrequenz-Phasenentfaltung). Gibt eine ``table`` zurück.
index_text.hi: Sense — indirect ToF depth with dual-frequency phase unwrapping sense sensing optics 3D Reconstruction time-of-flight camera (CW-iToF): simulate 4-phase correlation samples at 80 and 100 MHz with shot noise, recover phase / amplitude, then unwrap with the two frequencies (ML) to metric depth in m; the scene lies beyond the 1.87 m single-frequency ambiguity range and is recovered to 3 cm depth map → indirect ToF का raw signal (हर modulation frequency पर K phase-step bucket, electrons में)। ``table`` (``dict``) लौटाता है। K-step raw signal → phase, amplitude, offset, wrapped depth और हर pixel के depth noise का अनुमान (``table``)। कई frequency की phase → depth (multi-frequency unwrapping)। ``table`` लौटाता है।

recipes.name: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT
recipes.when: optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um
recipes.when_ja: 膜厚計測(OCT) — 分光干渉の A スキャンで塗膜・フィルムの 2 界面を見つけ、層の厚みを求める

index_text.ja: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um 膜厚計測(OCT) — 分光干渉の A スキャンで塗膜・フィルムの 2 界面を見つけ、層の厚みを求める 層の並び(``sample``)を OCT で 1 本測った**干渉スペクトル**(``table``)。 k 等間隔の干渉スペクトル → **A スキャン**(深さ方向の反射の振幅、``table``)。 A スキャンの界面のピーク → **層の光学厚と物理厚**(``table``)。分離できない・見えないときは拒否する。
index_text.en: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um The **spectral interferogram** of one OCT measurement of a layer stack (``sample``) (``table``). k-linear spectral interferogram → **A-scan** (reflection amplitude along depth, ``table``). Interface peaks of an A-scan → **optical and physical layer thicknesses** (``table``). Refuses when the interfaces cannot be separated or seen.
index_text.zh: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um 用 OCT 对层结构(``sample``)测量一次得到的**干涉光谱**(``table``)。 k 等间隔的干涉光谱 → **A 扫描**(沿深度方向的反射振幅,``table``)。 A 扫描中界面的峰 → **层的光学厚度与物理厚度**(``table``)。无法分离或看不到时拒绝。
index_text.tw: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um 用 OCT 對層結構(``sample``)量測一次得到的**干涉光譜**(``table``)。 k 等間隔的干涉光譜 → **A 掃描**(沿深度方向的反射振幅,``table``)。 A 掃描中界面的峰 → **層的光學厚度與物理厚度**(``table``)。無法分離或看不到時拒絕。
index_text.ko: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um 층 구조(``sample``)를 OCT로 한 번 측정한 **간섭 스펙트럼**(``table``). k 등간격의 간섭 스펙트럼 → **A 스캔**(깊이 방향 반사 진폭, ``table``). A 스캔의 계면 피크 → **층의 광학 두께와 물리 두께**(``table``). 분리할 수 없거나 보이지 않으면 거부한다.
index_text.de: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um Das **spektrale Interferogramm** einer OCT-Messung eines Schichtstapels (``sample``) (``table``). k-lineares spektrales Interferogramm → **A-Scan** (Reflexionsamplitude über der Tiefe, ``table``). Grenzflächen-Peaks eines A-Scans → **optische und physikalische Schichtdicken** (``table``). Verweigert, wenn sich die Grenzflächen nicht trennen oder nicht sehen lassen.
index_text.hi: Measure — coating thickness by spectral-domain OCT measure measurement optics  optical coherence tomography for industrial film / paint layers: simulate the 840 nm SD-OCT interference spectrum of a PMMA layer, FFT to an A-scan, pick the two interface peaks and divide the optical thickness by the PMMA group index; physical thickness in um within 0.6 um एक layer stack (``sample``) के एक OCT measurement का **spectral interferogram** (``table``)। k-linear spectral interferogram → **A-scan** (गहराई के साथ परावर्तन का आयाम, ``table``)। A-scan के interface peaks → **layer की optical और physical मोटाई** (``table``)। interfaces अलग न हो सकें या दिखें नहीं तो इनकार करता है।

recipes.name: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images)
recipes.when: polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 %
recipes.when_ja: 偏光による形状計測 — 偏光カメラ 4 方位の画像から光沢面の法線を求め、曲率を得る

index_text.ja: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % 偏光による形状計測 — 偏光カメラ 4 方位の画像から光沢面の法線を求め、曲率を得る Render the images a 4-direction polarisation camera records of a dielectric surface with the given normal map (the forward model of shape from polarisation). From a polariser sweep to the explicit set of candidate surface normals per pixel — 2 for the diffuse model, 4 for the specular model (2 zeniths x 2 azimuths). Pick one normal per pixel from the candidate set of :func:`sfp_normals`, using a stated prior — convexity with Brewster-ridge segmentation, or a coarse depth / normal map. 法線マップ (H, W, 3) → 曲率の地図 (H, W)。傾きを 1 回微分するだけで、高さへ積分しない。
index_text.en: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % Render the images a 4-direction polarisation camera records of a dielectric surface with the given normal map (the forward model of shape from polarisation). From a polariser sweep to the explicit set of candidate surface normals per pixel — 2 for the diffuse model, 4 for the specular model (2 zeniths x 2 azimuths). Pick one normal per pixel from the candidate set of :func:`sfp_normals`, using a stated prior — convexity with Brewster-ridge segmentation, or a coarse depth / normal map. Normal map (H, W, 3) → a curvature map (H, W). One derivative of the slopes, no integration to height.
index_text.zh: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % 渲染 4 方向偏振相机拍摄给定法线图的电介质表面所得的图像(偏振形状恢复的正向模型,``polsweep``)。 由偏振扫描得到每个像素表面法线的显式候选集 —— 漫射 2 个,镜面 4 个(天顶 2 × 方位 2)(``table``)。 用明确的先验从 ``sfp_normals`` 的候选中为每个像素选 1 个法线 —— 凸性 + Brewster 脊线分割,或粗略深度/法线(``normalmap``)。 法线图 (H, W, 3) → 曲率图 (H, W)。只对斜率求一次导数,不积分成高度。
index_text.tw: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % 繪製 4 方向偏振相機拍攝給定法線圖之介電質表面所得的影像(偏振形狀復原的正向模型,``polsweep``)。 由偏振掃描得到每個像素表面法線的顯式候選集 —— 漫射 2 個,鏡面 4 個(天頂 2 × 方位 2)(``table``)。 用明確的先驗從 ``sfp_normals`` 的候選中為每個像素選 1 個法線 —— 凸性 + Brewster 脊線分割,或粗略深度/法線(``normalmap``)。 法線圖 (H, W, 3) → 曲率圖 (H, W)。只對斜率求一次導數,不積分成高度。
index_text.ko: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % 주어진 법선 맵의 유전체 표면을 4방향 편광 카메라로 찍은 영상을 그린다 (편광 기반 형상 복원의 순방향, ``polsweep``). 편광 영상에서 화소별 면 법선 후보 집합을 명시적으로 반환 — 확산 2개, 정반사 4개(천정 2 × 방위 2) (``table``). 명시한 사전 정보로 ``sfp_normals``의 후보에서 화소마다 하나를 고른다 — 볼록성 + Brewster 능선 분할, 또는 거친 깊이/법선 (``normalmap``). 법선 맵 (H, W, 3) → 곡률 맵 (H, W). 기울기를 한 번 미분할 뿐 높이로 적분하지 않는다.
index_text.de: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % Rendert die Bilder, die eine 4-Richtungs-Polarisationskamera von einer dielektrischen Fläche mit gegebener Normalenkarte aufnimmt (Vorwärtsmodell von Shape from Polarization, ``polsweep``). Vom Polarisator-Sweep zur expliziten Menge der Kandidaten-Normalen je Pixel — 2 im diffusen, 4 im spiegelnden Modell (2 Zenit × 2 Azimut) (``table``). Wählt je Pixel eine Normale aus den Kandidaten von ``sfp_normals`` mit einem angegebenen Vorwissen — Konvexität mit Brewster-Kamm-Segmentierung oder eine grobe Tiefe/Normalenkarte (``normalmap``). Normalenkarte (H, W, 3) → Krümmungskarte (H, W). Eine Ableitung der Neigungen, keine Integration zur Höhe.
index_text.hi: 3D — shape from polarization of a glossy dome (curvature from polarization images) 3d 3d optics 3D Reconstruction polarization camera (0/45/90/135 deg) images of a specular dielectric dome (n = 1.5) are inverted per pixel to zenith / azimuth candidates, the convex prior resolves the ambiguity, and the normal map gives the mean curvature in 1/px: -1/R of the sphere (convex negative) within 3 % दिए गए normal map वाली dielectric सतह की 4-दिशा polarisation camera से ली गई images बनाना (shape from polarisation का forward model, ``polsweep``)। polariser sweep से हर pixel के surface normal के उम्मीदवारों का स्पष्ट समुच्चय — diffuse में 2, specular में 4 (2 zenith × 2 azimuth) (``table``)। बताए गए prior से ``sfp_normals`` के उम्मीदवारों में से हर pixel के लिए एक normal चुनना — convexity और Brewster ridge segmentation, या मोटा depth/normal map (``normalmap``)। normal map (H, W, 3) → curvature map (H, W)। slopes का केवल एक derivative, height में integration नहीं।

recipes.name: Optics — object-side telecentric lens: magnification and telecentricity error
recipes.when: gauging optics: a telecentric lens keeps the same magnification when the part moves in depth; real ray trace of the design gives the magnification (within 2 % of design) and the relative size error over a 1 mm height step (< 0.1 %) — why telecentric lenses are used for dimensional measurement
recipes.when_ja: テレセントリックレンズ — 光線追跡で倍率と、部品が奥行き方向に動いたときの寸法誤差を求める

index_text.en: Optics — object-side telecentric lens: magnification and telecentricity error design optics optics Calibration gauging optics: a telecentric lens keeps the same magnification when the part moves in depth; real ray trace of the design gives the magnification (within 2 % of design) and the relative size error over a 1 mm height step (< 0.1 %) — why telecentric lenses are used for dimensional measurement Prescriptions of three imaging lenses made from the same singlet by moving only the stop (a `raytrace.lens_system` table). recipes.name: Optics — peak wavelength of a blackbody source (Wien's law, spectral radiometry)
recipes.when: spectral radiometry of a halogen / blackbody light source: Planck spectrum on a 5 nm grid and its statistics; the peak wavelength in nm follows Wien's displacement law 2.898e6 nm K / T
recipes.when_ja: 分光放射 — ハロゲン・黒体光源のプランク分布からピーク波長(nm、ウィーンの変位則)を求める

index_text.ja: Optics — peak wavelength of a blackbody source (Wien's law, spectral radiometry) measure optics optics  spectral radiometry of a halogen / blackbody light source: Planck spectrum on a 5 nm grid and its statistics; the peak wavelength in nm follows Wien's displacement law 2.898e6 nm K / T 分光放射 — ハロゲン・黒体光源のプランク分布からピーク波長(nm、ウィーンの変位則)を求める 黒体の分光放射輝度 L(λ, T)、単位 W m⁻² sr⁻¹ nm⁻¹(Planck の式、SI 2019 の定数)。 曲線の要約: ピーク波長と値、重心波長、半値全幅(線形補間で交点を取る)、積分。
index_text.en: Optics — peak wavelength of a blackbody source (Wien's law, spectral radiometry) measure optics optics  spectral radiometry of a halogen / blackbody light source: Planck spectrum on a 5 nm grid and its statistics; the peak wavelength in nm follows Wien's displacement law 2.898e6 nm K / T Spectral radiance of a blackbody L(λ, T), in W m⁻² sr⁻¹ nm⁻¹ (Planck's law, SI 2019 constants). Summary of a curve: peak wavelength and value, centroid wavelength, full width at half maximum (crossings by linear interpolation), integral.

index_text.ja: Measure — photoelastic retardance and principal-stress direction (polarization camera) measure measurement optics  stress inspection in glass / epoxy: retardance delta = 2 pi t C (s1-s2)/lambda (rad) under circularly polarized light is imaged by a 4-direction polarization camera and inverted in closed form to retardance and fast-axis angle in degrees 光弾性による応力検査 — 偏光カメラでガラス・樹脂の位相差(リタデーション)と主応力方向を求める 円偏光照明の試料を偏光カメラ(0/45/90/135 度)または 6 強度の偏光計で撮った像 → (K, H, W)。 偏光像から位相差 δ と主軸 θ を閉形式で逆算 → dict。

recipes.name: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table)
recipes.when: chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um
recipes.when_ja: 白色共焦点変位計 — レンズの軸上色収差を設計し、反射スペクトルのピークから校正表で高さを求める

index_text.ja: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um 白色共焦点変位計 — レンズの軸上色収差を設計し、反射スペクトルのピークから校正表で高さを求める 対物レンズの処方から、波長 → 焦点位置の較正表(虹のものさしの目盛)を作る。 面の位置と層構成から、クロマティック共焦点の戻りスペクトルを合成する(順モデル)。 戻りスペクトルのピーク波長を(1 本または透明体の表裏の 2 本)サブビンで拾う。 ピーク波長を較正表で高さ(z)へ戻し、2 ピークなら透明な層の厚さを出す。
index_text.en: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um Build the wavelength → focus-position calibration table (the ticks of the rainbow ruler) from an objective lens prescription. Synthesise the chromatic confocal return spectrum from the surface position and the layer stack (forward model). Pick the peak wavelengths of a return spectrum (one, or the two faces of a transparent body) to sub-bin precision. Map peak wavelengths back to heights (z) through the calibration table and, for two peaks, give the thickness of the transparent layer.
index_text.zh: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um 由物镜的处方生成波长 → 焦点位置的标定表(彩虹标尺的刻度)。 由表面位置和层结构合成彩色共焦的返回光谱(正向模型)。 以优于一个采样间隔的精度提取返回光谱的峰值波长(一条,或透明体正反两面的两条)。 通过标定表把峰值波长换算回高度(z),若有两个峰则给出透明层的厚度。
index_text.tw: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um 由物鏡的處方產生波長 → 焦點位置的校正表(彩虹尺的刻度)。 由表面位置與層結構合成彩色共焦的返回光譜(正向模型)。 以優於一個取樣間隔的精度擷取返回光譜的峰值波長(一條,或透明體正反兩面的兩條)。 透過校正表把峰值波長換算回高度(z),若有兩個峰則給出透明層的厚度。
index_text.ko: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um 대물렌즈 처방으로부터 파장 → 초점 위치의 보정표(무지개 자의 눈금)를 만든다. 면의 위치와 층 구성으로부터 크로매틱 공초점의 귀환 스펙트럼을 합성한다(순방향 모델). 귀환 스펙트럼의 피크 파장(1개, 또는 투명체 앞뒷면의 2개)을 bin 이하의 정밀도로 찾는다. 피크 파장을 보정표로 높이(z)로 되돌리고, 피크가 2개이면 투명층의 두께를 구한다.
index_text.de: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um Erstellt aus dem Rezept des Objektivs die Kalibriertabelle Wellenlänge → Fokuslage (die Teilung des Regenbogen-Maßstabs). Synthetisiert das zurückkehrende Spektrum eines chromatisch-konfokalen Sensors aus Oberflächenlage und Schichtaufbau (Vorwärtsmodell). Bestimmt die Peakwellenlängen eines zurückkehrenden Spektrums (einer, oder Vorder- und Rückseite eines transparenten Körpers) genauer als ein Spektralbin. Rechnet Peakwellenlängen über die Kalibriertabelle in Höhen (z) um und liefert bei zwei Peaks die Dicke der transparenten Schicht.
index_text.hi: Measure — height with a chromatic confocal probe (designed lens, calibration table) measure measurement optics  chromatic confocal displacement sensor designed from a real lens prescription: ray-traced axial chromatic focus vs wavelength (1.19 mm range), the return spectrum of a mirror-like aluminium surface, sub-bin peak wavelength and the inverse calibration back to height in um objective lens के prescription से wavelength → focus स्थिति की calibration table (इंद्रधनुषी पैमाने के निशान) बनाता है। surface की स्थिति और layer संरचना से chromatic confocal का लौटने वाला spectrum बनाता है (forward model)। लौटे spectrum की peak wavelengths (एक, या पारदर्शी वस्तु की आगे-पीछे की दो) को एक bin से सूक्ष्म शुद्धता से निकालता है। peak wavelengths को calibration table से ऊँचाई (z) में बदलता है, और दो peaks हों तो पारदर्शी परत की मोटाई देता है।

recipes.name: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map)
recipes.when: automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s
recipes.when_ja: FMCW レーダー — 77 GHz レーダーのレンジ・ドップラーマップから対象の距離(m)と速度(m/s)を求める

index_text.ja: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s FMCW レーダー — 77 GHz レーダーのレンジ・ドップラーマップから対象の距離(m)と速度(m/s)を求める Synthesise the complex ``(A, C, S)`` beat cube for known targets. Apply a periodic window along the range and/or Doppler axis of a beat cube. The 2-D FFT of a beat cube -> a ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` magnitude map. Detections from a range-Doppler map: bin indices back to metres and m/s.
index_text.en: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s Synthesise the complex ``(A, C, S)`` beat cube for known targets. Apply a periodic window along the range and/or Doppler axis of a beat cube. The 2-D FFT of a beat cube -> a ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` magnitude map. Detections from a range-Doppler map: bin indices back to metres and m/s.
index_text.zh: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s 为已知目标合成复数 ``(A, C, S)`` 拍频立方体。 沿拍频立方体的距离轴和/或多普勒轴施加周期窗。 拍频立方体的 2-D FFT -> ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` 幅度图。 由距离-多普勒图得到检测:把 bin 索引换回米与 m/s。
index_text.tw: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s 為已知目標合成複數 ``(A, C, S)`` 拍頻立方體。 沿拍頻立方體的距離軸和/或都卜勒軸施加週期窗。 拍頻立方體的 2-D FFT -> ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` 振幅圖。 由距離-都卜勒圖得到偵測:把 bin 索引換回公尺與 m/s。
index_text.ko: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s 알려진 표적에 대한 복소 ``(A, C, S)`` 비트 큐브를 합성합니다. 비트 큐브의 거리축·도플러축을 따라 주기 창을 적용합니다. 비트 큐브의 2-D FFT -> ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` 크기 맵. 거리-도플러 맵으로부터의 검출: 빈 인덱스를 m 와 m/s 로 되돌립니다.
index_text.de: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s Synthetisiert den komplexen ``(A, C, S)``-Beat-Würfel für bekannte Ziele. Wendet ein periodisches Fenster entlang der Entfernungs- und/oder Doppler-Achse eines Beat-Würfels an. Die 2-D-FFT eines Beat-Würfels -> eine ``(n_doppler, n_range)``-Betragskarte. Detektionen aus einer Range-Doppler-Karte: Bin-Indizes zurück in Meter und m/s.
index_text.hi: Sense — FMCW radar range and velocity of a target (range-Doppler map) sense sensing rangedoppler  automotive / industrial 77 GHz FMCW radar: beat signal of one moving target (64 samples x 32 chirps), Hann range window, 2-D FFT range-Doppler map, strongest peak converted with the 1.171 m range bin and 1.217 m/s velocity bin to range m and radial velocity m/s ज्ञात targets के लिए complex ``(A, C, S)`` beat cube synthesise करता है। beat cube के range और/या Doppler axis के साथ periodic window लगाता है। beat cube का 2-D FFT -> ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` magnitude map। range-Doppler map से detections: bin indices को वापस metres और m/s में।

recipes.name: Preprocess — reveal faint stars: cosmic-ray reject, register and stack dithered frames
recipes.when: astro / low-light imaging pipeline: per-pixel temporal cosmic-ray rejection, star-matched registration of the dithered exposures, sigma-clipped stack, then source detection on the deep image; it recovers the field's stars (count) that single frames lose in noise
recipes.when_ja: 微光天体の抽出 — 宇宙線除去・位置合わせ・積算で暗い星を浮かび上がらせて検出する

index_text.ja: Preprocess — reveal faint stars: cosmic-ray reject, register and stack dithered frames preprocess preprocess astrostack  astro / low-light imaging pipeline: per-pixel temporal cosmic-ray rejection, star-matched registration of the dithered exposures, sigma-clipped stack, then source detection on the deep image; it recovers the field's stars (count) that single frames lose in noise 微光天体の抽出 — 宇宙線除去・位置合わせ・積算で暗い星を浮かび上がらせて検出する 同じ星野を ``n_frames`` 枚、**別々のノイズと別々のディザ**で撮り直す。 フレーム間比較による宇宙線除去 —— **同じ場所に二度は当たらない**。 フレーム列を 1 枚の基準へ重ね合わせる。 フレーム列を合成する(平均 / 中央値 / κ-σ クリップ)。採否マスクつき。 星を検出して ``(row, col)`` の重心列を返す。
index_text.en: Preprocess — reveal faint stars: cosmic-ray reject, register and stack dithered frames preprocess preprocess astrostack  astro / low-light imaging pipeline: per-pixel temporal cosmic-ray rejection, star-matched registration of the dithered exposures, sigma-clipped stack, then source detection on the deep image; it recovers the field's stars (count) that single frames lose in noise Re-shoot the same star field ``n_frames`` times, **each with its own noise and its own dither**. Cosmic-ray removal by comparing frames — **it never hits the same place twice**. Register a series of frames onto one reference. Combine a series of frames (mean / median / κ-σ clipping), with the accept/reject mask. Detect stars and return their ``(row, col)`` centroids.

recipes.name: 3D — metric depth from a light field (EPI structure-tensor slope, camera-array model)
recipes.when: light-field depth without a sweep: per-pixel EPI line orientation by the structure tensor, refined by shearing the 5x5 views with integer slopes until only a |r| <= 1/2 residual is measured (unbiased to 0.01 px/view for |s| <= 3), then depth = f b / |s| (focal 1000 px, baseline 1 unit): 1000 or 667 units
recipes.when_ja: ライトフィールドの EPI 傾きから距離を測る — 5x5 視点の光場で、エピポーラ平面画像の直線の傾きを構造テンソルで画素ごとに求める(焦点掃引なし)。整数スロープで視点をずらしてから残差だけを測る反復で |s| <= 3 まで 0.01 px/view 以内に偏りなく、Z = f b / |s| で 1000 / 667 単位の深度になる

recipes.name: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation)
recipes.when: particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s
recipes.when_ja: PIV 流速計測 — 粒子画像 2 枚の多段相互相関から流速(m/s)の分布を求める

index_text.ja: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation) measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s PIV 流速計測 — 粒子画像 2 枚の多段相互相関から流速(m/s)の分布を求める 粗い窓から細かい窓へ段を下げる多段 PIV。返りは ``(flow, info)``。 画素/フレーム → m/s。**両方とも必須引数**(既定値を置かない)。 ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``。向きを捨てる**一方向**の変換。
index_text.en: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation) measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s Multi-pass PIV that steps down from coarse windows to fine windows. Returns ``(flow, info)``. Pixels/frame → m/s. **Both are required arguments** (no default values are provided). ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``. A **one-way** conversion that discards the direction.
index_text.zh: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation) measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s 从粗窗口逐级降到细窗口的多级 PIV。返回 ``(flow, info)``。 像素/帧 → m/s。**两者都是必需参数**(不设默认值)。 ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``。舍弃方向的**单向**变换。
index_text.tw: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation) measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s 從粗視窗逐級降到細視窗的多級 PIV。回傳 ``(flow, info)``。 像素/影格 → m/s。**兩者皆為必要引數**(不設預設值)。 ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``。捨棄方向的**單向**轉換。
index_text.ko: Measure — flow velocity from a PIV image pair (multipass cross-correlation) measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry: two exposures of seeded flow, window-deformation multipass correlation 32 -> 16 px with Gaussian sub-pixel peaks, calibrated to m/s with 10 um pixels and 1 ms pulse separation; median speed in m/s 거친 창에서 세밀한 창으로 단계를 낮춰 가는 다단 PIV. 반환값은 ``(flow, info)``. 픽셀/프레임 → m/s. **둘 다 필수 인수**(기본값을 두지 않는다). ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``. 방향을 버리는 **일방향** 변환.

recipes.name: Measure — mean flow from a PIV image sequence (ensemble correlation)
recipes.when: low-seeding / micro-PIV: correlation planes of all consecutive pairs are averaged before peak finding, giving the mean displacement in px/frame where single pairs are too sparse (32 px windows; a quarter-pixel component still reads ~2 % low from peak locking with 2.5 px particles, 4 % at 16 px windows)
recipes.when_ja: PIV 平均流速 — 粒子が少ない画像列でも相関を平均して、平均の変位(px/フレーム)を求める

index_text.ja: Measure — mean flow from a PIV image sequence (ensemble correlation) measure measurement piv  low-seeding / micro-PIV: correlation planes of all consecutive pairs are averaged before peak finding, giving the mean displacement in px/frame where single pairs are too sparse (32 px windows; a quarter-pixel component still reads ~2 % low from peak locking with 2.5 px particles, 4 % at 16 px windows) PIV 平均流速 — 粒子が少ない画像列でも相関を平均して、平均の変位(px/フレーム)を求める 同じ粒子を繰り返し動かした画像列。返りは ``(frames, truth)``。 相関マップを**足してから**ピークを探す(アンサンブル相関)。 ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``。向きを捨てる**一方向**の変換。
index_text.en: Measure — mean flow from a PIV image sequence (ensemble correlation) measure measurement piv  low-seeding / micro-PIV: correlation planes of all consecutive pairs are averaged before peak finding, giving the mean displacement in px/frame where single pairs are too sparse (32 px windows; a quarter-pixel component still reads ~2 % low from peak locking with 2.5 px particles, 4 % at 16 px windows) Image sequence in which the same particles are moved repeatedly. recipes.name: Measure — vorticity of a PIV vector field after outlier replacement
recipes.when: particle image velocimetry post-processing: normalized median test flags spurious vectors, they are replaced by the neighbourhood median, and vorticity (1/frame) of a solid-body rotation equals -2 w in image coordinates (components (dy, dx))
recipes.when_ja: PIV 渦度 — 誤ベクトルを中央値で置き換えてから、流れ場の渦度(回転の強さ)を求める

index_text.ja: Measure — vorticity of a PIV vector field after outlier replacement measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry post-processing: normalized median test flags spurious vectors, they are replaced by the neighbourhood median, and vorticity (1/frame) of a solid-body rotation equals -2 w in image coordinates (components (dy, dx)) PIV 渦度 — 誤ベクトルを中央値で置き換えてから、流れ場の渦度(回転の強さ)を求める 正規化中央値検定(Westerweel & Scarano 2005)で外れベクトルを見つける。 外れ値を近傍で埋める。``method="nan"`` なら**埋めずに欠測にする**。 渦度 ``d(dx)/dy - d(dy)/dx``。**反時計回りが正**(画像座標での定義)。
index_text.en: Measure — vorticity of a PIV vector field after outlier replacement measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry post-processing: normalized median test flags spurious vectors, they are replaced by the neighbourhood median, and vorticity (1/frame) of a solid-body rotation equals -2 w in image coordinates (components (dy, dx)) Finds outlier vectors with the normalised median test (Westerweel & Scarano 2005). Fills outliers from their neighbourhood. With ``method="nan"`` they are **not filled but marked as missing**. Vorticity ``d(dx)/dy - d(dy)/dx``. **Counter-clockwise is positive** (defined in image coordinates).
index_text.zh: Measure — vorticity of a PIV vector field after outlier replacement measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry post-processing: normalized median test flags spurious vectors, they are replaced by the neighbourhood median, and vorticity (1/frame) of a solid-body rotation equals -2 w in image coordinates (components (dy, dx)) 用归一化中值检验(Westerweel & Scarano 2005)找出离群矢量。 用邻域填补离群值。若 ``method="nan"`` 则**不填补而记为缺测**。 涡量 ``d(dx)/dy - d(dy)/dx``。**逆时针为正**(在图像坐标中的定义)。

index_text.ko: Measure — vorticity of a PIV vector field after outlier replacement measure measurement piv  particle image velocimetry post-processing: normalized median test flags spurious vectors, they are replaced by the neighbourhood median, and vorticity (1/frame) of a solid-body rotation equals -2 w in image coordinates (components (dy, dx)) 정규화 중앙값 검정(Westerweel & Scarano 2005)으로 이상 벡터를 찾는다. 이상값을 근방 값으로 메운다. ``method="nan"``이면 **메우지 않고 결측으로 둔다**. 와도 ``d(dx)/dy - d(dy)/dx``. **반시계 방향이 양**(영상 좌표에서의 정의).

Richtungsselektive Antwort über das ganze Auge, in den sechs hexagonalen Richtungen. Sechs Richtungsantworten pro Ommatidium hinein, ein lokaler Flussvektor heraus. Kleinste-Quadrate-Rotation des Auges aus seinem Flussfeld — und wie schlecht die eigene Form des Auges die Lösung konditioniert.

recipes.name: Sense — time to collision with a wall from depth and ego motion
recipes.when: time-to-collision (TTC, τ) map in seconds for an approaching obstacle: the camera's two poses (world→camera 4×4) give the relative rigid motion, then each depth pixel (m) is moved and τ = Z·Δt/(Z0−Z1) (Lee 1976). Exact for constant speed — the ground truth to score a vision TTC estimator (forward collision warning, AEB). Sample: tilted wall 20–33 m, closing 10/14 m/s.
recipes.when_ja: 衝突余裕時間(TTC) — 深度画像と自車の動きから、障害物にぶつかるまでの時間(秒)を求める

recipes.when: focus of expansion (FoE, px col/row) = where the vehicle is heading in the image: the projection of the translation between two camera poses (pure translation required). recipes.when: radar / sonar / microphone-array bearing estimation: synthesize complex snapshots of an 8-element half-wavelength uniform linear array (20 dB SNR) for sources at known angles (deg), then MUSIC (Schmidt 1986) on the noise subspace returns the bearings; grid 0.05°.
recipes.when_ja: 到来方向推定 — アレイアンテナ・マイクアレイの信号から MUSIC 法で音源・電波源の方位(度)を求める

index_text.ja: Sense — direction of arrival of two sources with an antenna array (MUSIC) estimate sensing math  radar / sonar / microphone-array bearing estimation: synthesize complex snapshots of an 8-element half-wavelength uniform linear array (20 dB SNR) for sources at known angles (deg), then MUSIC (Schmidt 1986) on the noise subspace returns the bearings; grid 0.05°. 到来方向推定 — アレイアンテナ・マイクアレイの信号から MUSIC 法で音源・電波源の方位(度)を求める 等間隔線形アレイが受ける複素スナップショット (M, K) を作る(到来方向推定の答えの決まる入力)。 MUSIC(Schmidt 1986): 共分散の雑音部分空間に直交する向きを探す。
index_text.en: Sense — direction of arrival of two sources with an antenna array (MUSIC) estimate sensing math  radar / sonar / microphone-array bearing estimation: synthesize complex snapshots of an 8-element half-wavelength uniform linear array (20 dB SNR) for sources at known angles (deg), then MUSIC (Schmidt 1986) on the noise subspace returns the bearings; grid 0.05°. recipes.name: Analyze — algebraic connectivity of a neuron ring (Laplacian spectrum)

recipes.when: the transformer attention kernel written out stage by stage: RMS-normalise the query tokens (T, d), scaled dot-product scores against the keys, row softmax, convex mix of the values. With one-hot queries/keys a sharp softmax must copy value row i — the retrieval sanity check.

Raw attention scores QKᵀ/√d → attnmap (T, S). Row-wise softmax (with mask) → attnmap. **Row sums are 1 and mask positions are exactly 0**. An image obtained by normalizing the Euclidean distance transform (``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) by its maximum value. It represents, for each foreground pixel, the distance to the nearest background pixel -- the larger the value, the "deeper" the pixel is inside the region. Note that the output type is ``image``, not ``region``. Equivalent to HALCON's ``distance_transform`` (Compute the distance transformation of a region.). Inverts the tones via ``1.0 - x`` (negative/positive inversion). This corresponds directly to HALCON's ``invert_image`` (Invert an image.) - an operation that is exactly equivalent, not an approximation. Hierarchical watershed by dynamics: attaches the dynamics saliency to the edges of the minimum spanning forest of the relief ``image`` (low places are basins) and returns the components joined by edges with saliency ≤ ``threshold`` (if ``n_regions`` is given, the smallest threshold that yields that many regions is used) (hierarchical_watershed).

recipes.name: Segment — marker-controlled watershed inside a mask (two touching parts, background kept out)
recipes.when: watersheds_marker with a mask: the part mask (grey > 0.25) as one label, two operator markers, and the gradient magnitude as the landscape. blob_split floods from the markers in descending order of its priority field, so the inverted gradient makes it a classic low-first watershed; it never leaves the mask, so the labelled area equals the mask area exactly and each part's area is right to ~3 % (the dam sits on the grey step between them).

recipes.name: 3D — find a known part's 6-DoF pose in a scene cloud (PPF surface matching)
recipes.when: HALCON find_surface_model: point-pair-feature voting (Drost 2010) over the model's oriented normals finds the pose without an initial guess, then ICP refines it; the ledger returns the pose canon (R, t) with scene ≈ model R^T + t. Scene = the part moved, 10 % of its points dropped, noise 0.005, 40 clutter points, shuffled — the bracket has no rotational symmetry, so the pose is unique. The scene reuses the model's sampling; an independently resampled scene is 1-3 deg off (ICP slides on the plates of this coarse model), see the sample's docstring.

recipes.name: 3D — height map from 4-step phase-shift fringes (decode, unwrap, scale)
recipes.when: fringe projection 3-D: 4 phase-shifted fringe images -> wrapped phase -> unwrapped phase -> height = k · phase (k = phase-to-height calibration factor, here 0.25 per rad). The plane's phase spans several 2π, so the unwrap step matters. Without ref_phase the height is relative: single-frequency unwrapping fixes it only up to a constant 2π·k offset (measured: the mean comes out 2π·k lower), so pass a reference-plane phase (ref_phase) for absolute height
